people.tiZh: Grok Bot 产品与工程负责人（SpaceXAI）
people.bioEn: Product and engineering lead on the Grok Bot team at SpaceXAI. He leads the official "What's new in Grok Bot" workshops and regularly demos how the team runs persistent agent teams for engineering and product work.
people.bioZh: SpaceXAI「Grok Bot」团队的产品与工程负责人，主持官方「What's new in Grok Bot」系列工作坊，常年演示团队如何用常驻智能体团队完成工程与产品工作。

episodes.tEn: Grok Bot Workshop: Attention Lists, Agent Teams & Cloud Agents with Roshan and Kevin
How AI Agents Work While You Sleep: Lauren Tan & Roshan Sadanani on Grok Bot and Grok 4.6

views.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents as colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; agents with their own computer and persistent identity unlock automation beyond coding.
views.zh: 智能体的设计应当简单：像同事一样与智能体对话，而不是微观管理工具调用；拥有独立电脑和持久身份的智能体，能把自动化扩展到编程之外的岗位。

views.en: The chat box limits agentic work; agents need their own environments to verify work, and multiple specialized agents with scoped memory beat one general agent.
views.zh: 聊天框限制了智能体式工作；智能体需要自己的环境来验证工作，多个各有所长、记忆范围受限的智能体胜过单个通用智能体。

views.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control and codebase health; software engineering demand is rising, not falling.
views.zh: 工程师从写代码转向管理智能体集群，聚焦品味、质量控制与代码库健康；软件工程需求在上升而非下降。

views.en: Efficient models like Grok 4.6 match top models at a fraction of the cost, democratizing agent use as rising AI costs favor cheaper inference.
views.zh: 像 Grok 4.6 这样的高效模型以极低成本比肩顶级模型，随着 AI 成本上升、推理更趋廉价，智能体的使用正在大众化。

views.en: Clean data foundations and canonical tables are essential for trusted agent insights; routines keep agents proactive and tools connected.
views.zh: 干净的数据基础和规范表对于可信的智能体洞察至关重要；例程让智能体保持主动并维持工具连接。

people.tiZh: SpaceXAI 首席工程师（Grok Bot）
people.bioEn: Principal engineer at SpaceXAI working on Grok Bot and creator of the open-source pstack agent toolkit, known for running large fleets of coding agents and shipping thousands of PRs a month. Previously on the React Compiler core team at Meta.
people.bioZh: SpaceXAI 首席工程师，参与 Grok Bot 开发，开源智能体工具包 pstack 的作者，以同时调度大批编程智能体、每月合并数千个 PR 而闻名。此前是 Meta React 编译器核心团队成员。

episodes.tEn: Building a 21+ Agent Grok Bot Team: Trust, Verification, and the Engineer as Manager
Scaling to 2,500 PRs a Month: Lauren on the Agent Trust Ladder
How I Shipped 2,500 PRs to Production with Trusted Agents

views.en: Trust, not raw capability, is the bottleneck: build environments, constraints, lints and verification skills so agents self-check and climb a trust ladder.
views.zh: 2026 年，他的判断从“让智能体更强”转向“让智能体可信”：真正的瓶颈是信任，而非能力。他主张搭建环境、约束、lint 与验证技能，让智能体自我检查并沿“信任阶梯”上行。

views.en: Verification is the single most important skill; deterministic parts move into scripts and CLIs, leaving only judgment-heavy work to agents.
views.zh: 他把验证视为最重要的技能：把确定性部分抽成脚本与 CLI，只把需要判断的工作留给智能体，让它们凭实证自检正确性。

views.en: The engineer becomes a manager of agents: encode intent into CI, type systems and architecture, and fix the environment rather than individual agents.
views.zh: 工程师的角色转为“智能体管理者”：把意图编码进 CI、类型系统与架构，出现失败模式时修环境而非修单个智能体。

views.en: Trust infrastructure, not PR count, was the goal; it produced 2,500 PRs a month, with agents merging their own code and review after landing.
views.zh: 他强调 2,500 个 PR/月从来不是目标，信任基础设施才是；由此智能体可自行合并代码、落地后再评审，反共识地放弃事前人工审查。

views.en: Agent-friendly frameworks make the easy path correct by default; skills shrink toward workflow, and mined chat transcripts turn corrections into reusable skills.
views.zh: 他深化到框架设计层面：让“容易的路”默认正确，技能趋于精简、聚焦工作流，并从聊天记录中挖掘纠正、沉淀为可复用技能。

people.tiZh: 艾伦研究所荣誉研究员
people.bioEn: Neuroscientist and one of the founders of the modern science of consciousness. Caltech professor from 1986 to 2013, longtime collaborator of Francis Crick on the neural correlates of consciousness, then chief scientist and president of the Allen Institute for Brain Science. Leading proponent of integrated information theory.
people.bioZh: 神经科学家，现代意识科学的奠基者之一。1986–2013 年任加州理工教授，与弗朗西斯·克里克合作 14 年寻找意识的神经相关物，后任艾伦脑科学研究所首席科学家兼所长。整合信息理论（IIT）的主要倡导者。

episodes.tEn: Detecting Hidden Consciousness: A Neuroscientist's Mission

people.tiEn: Creator of Lean; Co-creator of Z3
people.tiZh: Lean 定理证明器作者、Z3 联合作者
people.bioEn: Computer scientist who created the Lean theorem prover and co-created the Z3 SMT solver. Lean and its Mathlib library have become the standard tool for formalizing mathematics and verifying AI-generated proofs.
people.bioZh: 计算机科学家，Lean 定理证明器的作者、Z3 SMT 求解器的联合作者。Lean 及其 Mathlib 库已成为数学形式化和验证 AI 生成证明的标准工具。

episodes.tEn: The Programming Language That Referees Mathematics

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 研究副总裁（Cosmos 负责人）
people.bioEn: Leads the Cosmos world foundation model research at NVIDIA, working on models that understand and generate video, audio and robot actions for physical AI. Known earlier for GauGAN and image-to-image translation research.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 领导 Cosmos 世界基础模型研究，做能理解并生成视频、音频和机器人动作的物理 AI 模型。早年以 GauGAN 和图像到图像翻译研究知名。

episodes.tEn: How Physical AI Learns Across Language, Video and Action

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, CuspAI; Professor, University of Amsterdam
people.tiZh: CuspAI 联合创始人兼 CTO、阿姆斯特丹大学教授
people.bioEn: Machine learning researcher, co-inventor of the variational autoencoder and a pioneer of graph and equivariant neural networks. Professor at the University of Amsterdam and co-founder and CTO of CuspAI, which uses generative AI to design new materials.
people.bioZh: 机器学习研究者，变分自编码器（VAE）的共同提出者，图神经网络与等变网络的先驱。阿姆斯特丹大学教授，CuspAI 联合创始人兼 CTO，用生成式 AI 设计新材料。

episodes.tEn: Why the Next AI Breakthrough May Come from Physics
Max Welling: Physics, Symmetry, and AI for Materials Discovery

views.en: Physics is the unifying thread across symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery; AI for science is exploding now.
views.zh: 物理学是贯穿对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现的统一线索；AI for science 正因工具成熟与巨额投入而爆发。

views.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition; equivariant networks and ML force fields speed quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
views.zh: AI 设计的材料能加速能源转型；等变网络与机器学习力场把量子模拟提速数个数量级。

views.en: Generative AI math is equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics; diffusion models reverse entropy increase.
views.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价；扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增。

views.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures—symmetry breaking, waves, edge of chaos—not just Scaling larger models on more data.
views.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自物理启发的架构——对称性破缺、波、混沌边缘——而不只是靠 Scaling 把模型和数据做大。

views.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms compress discovery from years to days, yet domain experts stay in the loop; full automation is not the near-term vision.
views.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台把发现从数年压缩到数天，但领域专家仍在环路中；全自动化并非近期愿景。

people.bioZh: OpenAI 健康 AI 负责人，把医学能力训练进通用前沿模型并打造 ChatGPT 的健康功能。此前在 Google Research 领导 Med-PaLM 医疗大模型的研究。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Head of Health AI on Trusting ChatGPT with Your Health

people.bioZh: AI 硬件公司 Unconventional AI 创始人兼 CEO。此前创办 Nervana Systems（被英特尔收购），联合创办 MosaicML（被 Databricks 以 13 亿美元收购），并任 Databricks AI 副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Inference Will Be a $10 Trillion Market: Naveen Rao on Energy, Hardware, and the AI Buildout

people.bioZh: MIT 博士生，师从 Phillip Isola，并与 Sakana AI 合作。主导了用基础模型搜索人工生命空间的 ASAL 项目，与 Kenneth Stanley、Jeff Clune、Joel Lehman 合著「断裂纠缠表征」论文并任第一作者。

episodes.tEn: What Most People Get Wrong About Evolution: Artificial Life, Open-Endedness, and Intelligence Beyond Earth

episodes.tEn: Can Rewriting an AI Agent Bend the Intelligence Curve?

people.tiZh: MIT 数学系教授
people.bioEn: Theoretical computer scientist and professor of mathematics at MIT, working on algorithms, the theory of machine learning and high-dimensional statistics.
people.bioZh: 理论计算机科学家，MIT 数学系教授，研究算法、机器学习理论与高维统计。

episodes.tEn: AI Crisis in Mathematics: Navier-Stokes, Riemann Hypothesis, and Complexity Theory — Ankur Moitra, Steven Brunton, and Alex Kontorovich on the Future of Math

people.tiEn: Startup Advisor, Author of The Power of Pull
people.tiZh: 创业顾问,《The Power of Pull》作者
people.bioEn: Rob Snyder is a startup advisor and author of The Power of Pull, who has advised over 50 startups on growing from zero to $1 million in ARR. He writes the newsletter The Physics of Startups and focuses on frameworks for finding product-market fit.
people.bioZh: 罗布·斯奈德是一位创业顾问,著有《The Power of Pull》,曾为 50 多家初创公司提供从零增长到 100 万美元 ARR 的咨询。他撰写通讯《The Physics of Startups》,专注于寻找产品市场契合度的框架。

episodes.tEn: The Power of Pull: Why Customer Demand Beats Pain Points
An 86-Minute Guide to Finding Product-Market Fit

views.en: Pull is a property of a person with a project, not a company; demand means someone will buy now, not just feel pain.
views.zh: Pull 是拥有项目的人的特性，而非公司属性；需求意味着有人现在就会购买，而不只是感到痛点。

views.en: Avoid design partners and interviews; sales is research—test willingness to transact, not interest. Go to the gemba.
views.zh: 避开设计伙伴和用户访谈；销售即研究——测试交易意愿而非兴趣。去现场（gemba）观察。

views.en: Start with one hell-yes customer, then build a case study factory; retention is the leading indicator, not revenue.
views.zh: 从一个“绝对愿意”的客户开始，然后打造案例研究工厂；留存是领先指标，而非收入。

views.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; make the product seem small.
views.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，需求验证后再自动化；让产品看起来小而非大。

people.tiZh: Hey Clicky 创始人, Buildspace 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Hey Clicky and previously Buildspace, one of the largest online schools for people building their own ideas. He has made videos for over a decade, with posts regularly reaching millions of views.
people.bioZh: Hey Clicky 创始人, 此前创办 Buildspace——最大的在线创意建造学校之一。他做视频已超过十年, 作品常获数百万播放。

episodes.tEn: How to Actually Make Launch Videos That Convert

people.tiZh: Magic Patterns 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alex Danilowicz is a front-end engineer and co-founder of Magic Patterns, one of the first teams building prompt-to-design tools in 2023. Magic Patterns helps product teams turn ideas into interactive, code-backed prototypes in minutes.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·丹尼洛维奇是一名前端工程师，也是 Magic Patterns 的联合创始人。该团队是 2023 年最早构建提示词生成设计工具的团队之一，帮助产品团队在几分钟内把想法变成可交互、带代码的原型。

episodes.tEn: How to Stand Out in an AI Design World: Inside Magic Patterns

people.tiZh: Moshi 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Moshi, building AI-powered recommendation and research tools for commodity traders. Background in mathematics and trading.
people.bioZh: Moshi 创始人兼 CEO，为大宗商品交易员打造 AI 推荐与研究工具。拥有数学与交易背景。

episodes.tEn: Building the Recommendation Engine for Commodity Traders

people.tiZh: Modal 首席执行官
people.bioEn: CEO and founder of Modal, a serverless cloud platform for AI compute. Previously CTO at Better and engineering leader at Spotify, where he built its recommendation system.
people.bioZh: Modal 首席执行官兼创始人，Modal 是面向 AI 计算的无服务器云平台。此前曾任 Better 首席技术官，并在 Spotify 担任工程负责人，主导构建其推荐系统。

episodes.tEn: Modal CEO Erik: The $100B Inference Opportunity and Why Open-Source LLM Inference Hasn't Peaked
Modal CEO Erik on Agent Maxxing, Inference's Future, and the GPU Market's Chaos
Why AI Compute Comes in Rectangles: Erik Bernhardsson on Building Modal

views.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable; the real problem is three-year rectangular deals, not GPU scarcity itself.
views.zh: 算力稀缺但可获得，真正的问题是三年期“矩形”合约，而非 GPU 稀缺本身。

views.en: Inference is the next cloud: a full platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools, not token selling.
views.zh: 推理是下一个云：需要后训练、沙箱与智能体式工具的完整平台，而非卖 token。

views.en: Vertical integration—own file system, container runtime, scheduler—is durable alpha; CUDA is not the moat.
views.zh: 自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器才是持久优势；CUDA 不是护城河。

views.en: Open source is a strategy, not a concession: contribute to vLLM and SGLang while keeping infra alpha proprietary.
views.zh: 开源是战略而非让步：贡献 vLLM 与 SGLang，同时保留基础设施优势为专有。

views.en: Agents create incumbent staying power and help senior engineers; post-training works for finite-feedback tasks like coding.
views.zh: 智能体强化在位者优势并放大资深工程师；后训练适用于编码等有限反馈任务。

people.tiZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Mecka AI, which operates one of the largest robot data factories, building custom hardware and pipelines to collect egocentric human and robot data for training embodied models.
people.bioZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO，运营着规模最大的机器人数据工厂之一，通过自研硬件与数据管线采集第一人称人类数据和机器人数据，用于训练具身模型。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Robot Data Factory: Mecka's Josh Gao on Sensorizing Humans to Train Robots

people.tiZh: SF Compute 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of SF Compute, a marketplace and independent operator for buying and selling GPU compute capacity.
people.bioZh: SF Compute 联合创始人，该公司是 GPU 算力买卖的市场平台与独立运营商。

episodes.tEn: The Programmable Data Center: Evan Conrad of SF Compute

people.tiZh: Inflight 联合创始人、产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer and co-founder of Inflight, with design experience at Tinder, Facebook, and Airchat.
people.bioZh: 产品设计师、Inflight 联合创始人，曾在 Tinder、Facebook 和 Airchat 从事设计工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing Inflight: A Designer's Raw 0-to-1 Startup Journey

people.tiZh: Robinhood 联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Vladimir Tenev is the co-founder, chairman, and CEO of Robinhood. Born in Bulgaria, he moved to the United States at age five, studied mathematics at Stanford and UCLA, and started the brokerage with Baiju Bhatt.
people.bioZh: 弗拉基米尔·特内夫是 Robinhood 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO。他出生于保加利亚，五岁移居美国，在斯坦福和 UCLA 学习数学，并与 Baiju Bhatt 一起创办了这家券商。

episodes.tEn: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev on Tokenization, Agentic Trading, and Expanding Ownership
Robinhood’s CEO on Letting AI Trade Your Money

views.en: AI is too centralized; tools should empower individuals, not just big labs with secret models and data centers.
views.zh: AI 过于中心化；工具应赋能个体，而不只是拥有秘密模型和数据中心的大实验室。

views.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom and stability; broad ownership makes people defenders of the system.
views.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由与社会稳定的路径；广泛的所有权让人成为体系的捍卫者。

views.en: Agentic trading has clear product-market fit; tokenization extends ownership globally to anyone with a smartphone.
views.zh: 智能体式交易已有明确的产品市场契合；代币化把所有权扩展到全球任何有智能手机的人。

views.en: The edge is not a shared model but different data, tools, and strategies; giving everyone a powerful trading AI does not erase it.
views.zh: 优势不在共享模型，而在不同的数据、工具与策略；给每个人强大的交易 AI 并不会消除这种优势。

views.en: AI labs keeping the strongest models in-house and monopolizing discoveries is the worse, dystopian future.
views.zh: AI 实验室把最强模型留在内部、垄断发现，是更糟的、反乌托邦的未来。

people.tiZh: 高通总裁兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Cristiano Amon is President and CEO of Qualcomm. He joined as an engineer in 1995, led its 5G strategy and the Snapdragon platforms, and became CEO in 2021, taking the company from phones into PCs, cars, wearables and data-center AI.
people.bioZh: 克里斯蒂亚诺·安蒙是高通总裁兼 CEO。他 1995 年以工程师身份加入高通，主导 5G 战略与骁龙平台，2021 年出任 CEO，并把公司从手机拓展到 PC、汽车、可穿戴设备与数据中心 AI。

episodes.tEn: Qualcomm’s CEO on the Coming AI Phone Supercycle
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Reinventing Beyond the Phone
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on AI, Geopolitics, and the Gladiator Mindset
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the Rise of Agentic AI Devices
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the 6G Era and the Next AI Device
Beyond the Smartphone: Cristiano Amon on Qualcomm's AI Revolution and the Global Bridge
episodes.podEn: A Bit Personal with Jodi Shelton

episodes.tEn: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Personal AI Devices and the Agentic Future of Mobile
Qualcomm CEO on Robotics, Chips and Competition with China
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the Future of AI Devices
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon: The Next Mobile Revolution
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the AI-Driven Transformation of Computing
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon: We’re in a Hurry to Get to the Future
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on 5G, Snapdragon, and the Future of Mobile Computing
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Leading the Chip Giant Beyond Mobile

views.en: 5G as critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, CPU, GPU into one efficient SoC.
views.zh: 早期把 5G 定位为像电力一样连接万物的关键基础设施，强调 Snapdragon 把 5G、AI、CPU、GPU 集成进高能效 SoC，主线是连接与计算的融合。

views.en: Diversifying beyond phones into automotive, IoT, PCs, AR; autonomous driving incremental, AR glasses 5-10 years out.
views.zh: 2022 年明确从手机向汽车、物联网、PC、AR 多元化，认为自动驾驶渐进落地、AR 眼镜还需 5-10 年，多元化主线开始成形。

views.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency, efficiency.
views.zh: 2024 年叙事从无线通信转向“无处不在的智能计算”，提出端云混合 AI，以隐私、时延和能效为理由，端侧 AI 开始独立演进。

views.en: Agents become the new center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, phone shifts from center to peripheral but persists.
views.zh: 2026 年把智能体视为数字生活新中心，眼镜等可穿戴设备崛起，手机从中心转为外围但不会消失——这是对早期“手机中心论”的深化而非推翻。

views.en: Inference overtakes training; post-GPU, disaggregated, power-efficient data centers; edge-cloud continuum, not either-or.
views.zh: 到 2026 年进一步主张推理将超越训练，数据中心走向后 GPU、解耦、高能效架构，端云是连续体而非二选一，并把 6G 定义为 AI 原生的感知网络。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Emmanuel Ameisen is an interpretability researcher at Anthropic, studying how large language models like Claude form concepts and plan ahead. He previously worked in applied ML at Stripe and Insight and authored Building Machine Learning Powered Applications.
people.bioZh: Emmanuel Ameisen 是 Anthropic 的可解释性研究员，研究 Claude 等大语言模型如何形成概念、如何提前规划。他此前在 Stripe 和 Insight 从事应用机器学习工作，并著有《Building Machine Learning Powered Applications》。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Mind of AI: An Anthropic Researcher on How Models Really Work

people.tiZh: Metalab 设计总监
people.bioEn: Design Director at Metalab, where he builds internal AI tooling systems and custom AI tools for design teams.
people.bioZh: Metalab 设计总监，为设计团队构建内部 AI 工具系统与定制化 AI 工具。

episodes.tEn: Building Custom AI Design Tools at Metalab

people.tiZh: Dyna Robotics 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jason Ma is co-founder and Chief Scientist at Dyna Robotics, where he works on world-action models and general-purpose robot learning from large-scale human video. His research focuses on robot learning, reinforcement learning, and physical AI systems deployed in real-world production.
people.bioZh: 马杰森是 Dyna Robotics 的联合创始人兼首席科学家，专注于世界-动作模型以及从大规模人类视频中学习通用机器人技能。他的研究聚焦于机器人学习、强化学习，以及部署到真实生产环境中的物理 AI 系统。

episodes.tEn: Robots That Predict the Future: Dyna-2 and Physical AI with Jason Ma

people.tiZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Leash Bio, which builds DNA-encoded libraries and large-scale experimental datasets to train models that learn real chemistry. Works on turning wet-lab measurements into reinforcement-learning environments for drug-discovery agents.
people.bioZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO，通过 DNA 编码化合物库与大规模实验数据训练真正理解化学的模型，并致力于把湿实验测量转化为药物发现智能体的强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: From Wet Lab to RL Env: 10,000 Drug-Discovery Campaigns in a Weekend — Ian Quigley, Leash Bio

people.tiZh: Google Labs 与 Gemini 应用副总裁
people.bioEn: Josh Woodward is the VP of Google Labs and head of the Gemini app and AI Studio. He has spent over 17 years at Google, overseeing its largest labs team behind products like NotebookLM, Project Genie, and Flow.
people.bioZh: 乔什·伍德沃德是 Google Labs 副总裁，负责 Gemini 应用与 AI Studio。他在 Google 工作超过 17 年，掌管其规模最大的实验室团队，主导了 NotebookLM、Project Genie 和 Flow 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Why Every Company Now Needs to Think and Operate Like a Lab Team

people.tiEn: President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco
people.tiZh: 思科总裁兼首席产品官
people.bioEn: Jeetu Patel is President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco, where he leads the company's product strategy and AI infrastructure efforts, including networking for GPU clusters and securing AI agents.
people.bioZh: 吉图·帕特尔是思科总裁兼首席产品官，负责公司产品战略与 AI 基础设施业务，包括面向 GPU 集群的网络与 AI 智能体的安全。

episodes.tEn: Jeetu Patel: Building Products for the AI Era
episodes.podEn: A Bit Personal with Jodi Shelton

episodes.tEn: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World's Largest Startup

views.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained infrastructure is the real constraint.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，真正的瓶颈在人，而供给受限的基础设施才是核心约束。

views.en: Cisco's role is picks and shovels: AI infrastructure, networking, security, and silicon, not chasing the model frontier.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 Cisco 定位为“卖铲子的人”：做 AI 基础设施、网络、安全与芯片，而非追逐模型前沿。

views.en: Use AI to learn faster and build instinct, not to outsource learning; full delegation is a long-term mistake.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调用 AI 更快学习、建立直觉，而不是外包学习；完全委托给 AI 是长期错误。

views.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, use it as tailwind.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，应把它当顺风。

views.en: Operate like the world's largest startup: speed with scale, founder mode, and unlearning as a core AI-era skill.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出像全球最大初创公司那样运营：规模中保持速度、创始人模式，并把“忘掉旧经验”当作 AI 时代的核心技能。

people.tiZh: Bending Spoons 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Luca Ferrari is co-founder and CEO of Bending Spoons, a software company that acquires and operates products such as Evernote, Vimeo, AOL and Airtable. He is known for running hiring and operations with a heavily data-driven, quantitative approach.
people.bioZh: 卢卡·法拉利是 Bending Spoons 的联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司收购并运营 Evernote、Vimeo、AOL、Airtable 等产品。他以高度数据驱动、量化的招聘与运营方式著称。

episodes.tEn: Luca Ferrari: The Operating System Behind Bending Spoons

people.tiZh: OpenAI Dots 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Alexander Embiricos leads product for Dots, OpenAI's always-on personal AI agents that act without waiting for a prompt, after previously leading Codex. He co-founded and ran the collaboration startup Multi, which OpenAI acquired in 2024.
people.bioZh: 亚历山大·恩比里科斯是 OpenAI Dots 的产品负责人——Dots 是无需等待指令就能主动帮用户做事的常驻个人 AI 智能体；此前他负责 Codex 产品。他曾联合创办协作软件公司 Multi 并任 CEO，该公司 2024 年被 OpenAI 收购。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Dots Lead on the Future of ChatGPT and Personal Agents

people.tiZh: Applied Compute 首席执行官；前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Yash Patil is the CEO of Applied Compute and a former OpenAI researcher who worked on Codex. He focuses on post-training, reinforcement learning, and the inference-serving stack for production AI systems.
people.bioZh: 亚什·帕蒂尔是 Applied Compute 的首席执行官，曾任 OpenAI 研究员并参与 Codex 项目。他专注于后训练、强化学习以及生产级 AI 系统的推理服务栈。

episodes.tEn: Applied Compute CEO Yash on the Limits of RL, the New AI Hyperscaler, and Why Post-Training Wins Inference

people.tiEn: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家
people.bioEn: Amin Vahdat is Google's Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, leading the design of TPU systems and large-scale datacenter infrastructure that power Google's frontier AI models. He works closely with DeepMind on hardware-software co-design for training and serving at hundred-thousand-accelerator scale.
people.bioZh: 阿明·瓦赫达特是谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家，主导 TPU 系统与大规模数据中心基础设施的设计，为谷歌的前沿 AI 模型提供算力支撑。他与 DeepMind 紧密合作，围绕十万级加速器规模的训练与推理开展软硬件协同设计。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Infrastructure Chief on the Physics and Economics of Frontier AI

people.tiZh: 谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁
people.bioEn: Rhiannon Bell is VP of UX for Google Search, leading design for AI-driven search experiences such as AI Mode at Google scale.
people.bioZh: 里安农·贝尔是谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁，负责领导 AI Mode 等 AI 驱动搜索体验的大规模设计工作。

episodes.tEn: How Google Designs for AI at Scale

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT & Codex (Core Products), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 与 Codex 负责人（核心产品）
people.bioEn: Thibault "Tibo" Sottiaux leads OpenAI's core products, spanning ChatGPT, Codex and the Dots personal-agent platform. A Belgian engineer, he previously worked on Google Maps and ML infrastructure at Google DeepMind, where he briefly led Gemini's human-data team before joining OpenAI in 2024 as an engineering lead for Codex.
people.bioZh: 蒂博·索蒂奥统管 OpenAI 核心产品线，覆盖 ChatGPT、Codex 以及 Dots 个人智能体平台。他是比利时工程师，曾在 Google 做 Google Maps，后在 Google DeepMind 负责机器学习基础设施并短暂领导 Gemini 人类数据团队，2024 年加入 OpenAI 任 Codex 工程负责人。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Tibo Sottiaux on Putting Humans at the Center of AI
Why Most Internet Actions Will Soon Be Taken by AI Agents

views.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs, take most internet actions.
views.zh: 要为这样一个未来而构建：持久的、会学习的智能体——而非手工编排的循环与流程图——将承担互联网上的大多数操作。

views.en: Human taste, creativity and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing fast declines.
views.zh: 随着快速打字的价值下降，人类的品味、创造力以及判断“什么算好”的能力变得更加重要。

views.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision.
views.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

views.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary.
views.zh: 随着模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型可能并非必需。

views.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
views.zh: 拥有共享经济模式与安全栈的开放生态，将推动下一波 AI 应用浪潮。

people.tiZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员
people.bioEn: MIT PhD researcher working on Recursive Language Models, GPU kernels and KernelBench, and multi-agent systems. He studies how better harness design can unlock capabilities latent in existing models.
people.bioZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员，研究递归语言模型、GPU 内核与 KernelBench，以及多智能体系统。他关注更好的 harness 设计如何释放现有模型中潜在的能力。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Language Models — Alex Zhang, MIT PhD

people.tiZh: 领导力教练，前谷歌/Facebook 高管
people.bioEn: Molly Graham spent over 20 years in leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She hosts TED's WorkLife podcast and runs Glue Club, a leadership community for senior operators.
people.bioZh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆在谷歌、Facebook、Quip 和 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 担任领导职务超过 20 年。她主持 TED 的 WorkLife 播客，并运营面向资深运营者的领导力社区 Glue Club。

episodes.tEn: Molly Graham: The Grief, Burnout, and Opportunity Hiding Inside the AI Transition

people.tiZh: Decimals 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Danny Martinez is the CEO of Decimals, a platform focused on design hiring and talent. He has deep experience in design recruiting and building hiring processes for design teams.
people.bioZh: 丹尼·马丁内斯是 Decimals 的首席执行官，该平台专注于设计招聘与人才。他在设计招聘以及为设计团队搭建招聘流程方面拥有丰富经验。

episodes.tEn: Danny Martinez: Thriving in Today's Design Job Market

people.tiEn: Product & Engineering Lead, Computer Use, OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI Computer Use 产品与工程负责人
people.bioEn: Ari Weinstein leads product and engineering for Computer Use at OpenAI, working on agents that operate software end-to-end. He previously co-founded the automation app Workflow, which was acquired by Apple.
people.bioZh: 阿里·温斯坦是 OpenAI Computer Use 的产品与工程负责人，专注于让智能体端到端操作软件。他此前联合创办了自动化应用 Workflow，该公司后被苹果收购。

episodes.tEn: Why OpenAI Is Racing to Make Computer Use Superhuman
Inside OpenAI DevDay: Superhuman Computer Use, Decisions API, and the AI Cloud

views.en: Computer use has crossed from demo to superhuman speed, and the bottleneck is now website load time, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已从演示走向超人速度，瓶颈不再是模型智能，而是网站加载时间。

views.en: Agents can drive all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot-scroll loops, completing the dev lifecycle.
views.zh: 智能体可通过无障碍树和 DOM 操作所有人类设计的软件，而非截图滚动循环，从而完成完整开发周期。

views.en: The scaling moment for computer use has arrived in consumer and enterprise at once; proactivity and deterministic controls are the adoption keys.
views.zh: computer use 的 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻在消费端与企业端同时到来；主动性与确定性控制是落地关键。

views.en: Trust is shifting: people let agents configure DNS and pay bills, so sandboxing and human-in-the-loop dials must mature alongside capability.
views.zh: 信任正在转移：人们已让智能体配置 DNS、支付账单，因此沙箱与人类在环调节必须与能力同步成熟。

people.tiZh: Legora 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Junestrand is the co-founder and CEO of Legora, an AI legal-tech company whose products are used by over 3% of the world's lawyers. He led Legora from launch in October 2024 to $100M ARR, one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·尤内斯特兰德是 AI 法律科技公司 Legora 的联合创始人兼 CEO，其产品被全球超过 3% 的律师使用。他带领 Legora 从 2024 年 10 月上线到实现 1 亿美元 ARR，成为全球增长最快的企业软件公司之一。

episodes.tEn: How a 27-Year-Old Built a $5.6B AI Company in 21 Months
Max Junestrand: The Willingness to Learn Faster Than Anyone Else

views.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today; bet on model improvements instead of fine-tuning.
views.zh: 为 3-6 个月后的模型能力而构建，而不是为今天；押注模型进步，而非微调。

views.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
views.zh: AI 现在是它最差的状态；我们才刚跑完长马拉松的第一英里。

views.en: Domain expertise matters less than willingness to learn and build for the market.
views.zh: 领域专业知识不如学习和为市场构建的意愿重要。

views.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people for key roles.
views.zh: 领导者应通过在关键岗位招更聪明的人，让自己变得可被替代。

views.en: Culture and team must be invested in during good times to build a cushion for downturns.
views.zh: 必须在顺境时投资文化与团队，为低谷积累缓冲。

people.tiEn: Professor of Machine Learning, University of Freiburg; ELLIS Institute Tübingen
people.tiZh: 弗莱堡大学机器学习教授；ELLIS 图宾根研究所
people.bioEn: The researcher most responsible for making AutoML a field of its own: Auto-WEKA, Auto-sklearn and Auto-PyTorch came out of his lab, as did the first book on AutoML and the AutoML conference he founded as general chair. Full professor at Freiburg since 2016, director of the ELLIS unit there and a Hector Endowed Fellow at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen, with three ERC grants. PhD and postdoc at UBC. His recent work argues that prior structure, not more data, is what tabular and scientific models are still missing — the thesis behind TabPFN.
people.bioZh: 把 AutoML 做成一个独立领域的人：Auto-WEKA、Auto-sklearn、Auto-PyTorch 都出自他的实验室，第一本 AutoML 专著和 AutoML 会议也是他牵头。2016 年起任弗莱堡大学机器学习正教授，兼该校 ELLIS 分部主任、ELLIS 图宾根研究所 Hector 冠名研究员，持有三项 ERC 基金。博士与博士后均在英属哥伦比亚大学。近年他主张表格与科学建模缺的不是更多数据而是先验结构，这正是 TabPFN 背后的论点。

episodes.tEn: TabPFN: The AI That Replaces Hours of Model Tuning for Tabular Data

people.tiZh: Replit 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Born in Jordan, moved to the US to work on developer tools at Codecademy and then Facebook, and founded Replit in 2016 on the idea that a browser tab should be enough to write and ship software. Replit Agent (2024) turned that into agentic coding, and Agent 4 will build a startup from a plain-English description. A $400M Series D led by Georgian in March 2026 tripled the company to a $9B valuation on more than 50 million registered users, with Masad targeting $1B ARR by year end. Outspoken about education: his argument is that young people should learn to direct machines rather than compete with them.
people.bioZh: 生于约旦，赴美先后在 Codecademy 和 Facebook 做开发者工具，2016 年创办 Replit，押的是「一个浏览器标签页就该够写完并发布软件」。2024 年的 Replit Agent 把这件事推到智能体编程，Agent 4 能从一句大白话描述直接搭出一家初创公司的产品。2026 年 3 月 Georgian 领投 4 亿美元 D 轮，估值翻三倍到 90 亿美元，注册用户超 5000 万，他的目标是年底 10 亿美元年化收入。他在教育话题上直言不讳：年轻人该学的是指挥机器，而不是跟机器竞争。

episodes.tEn: Building the Future: Paul Graham & Amjad Masad on Vibe Coding and AI Agents
Replit CEO Amjad Masad on AI Doom, Software, and Vibe-Coding
Why Specialized AI Could Beat the God Model
Replit CEO Amjad Masad: What Young People Should Learn in the AI Era

views.en: Young people should explore and question beliefs rather than be prescriptive; AI enables interest-driven learning, and trust in their own paths builds the future.
views.zh: 年轻人应探索、质疑既有信念，而非被规定路径；AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能，信任年轻人走自己的路才能塑造未来。

views.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; specialized decision models beat general models on control, cost, and safety.
views.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上优于通用模型。

views.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all, but coders are still needed for systems and debugging; doomerism lacks good arguments and is commercially dressed-up.
views.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及，但仍需程序员理解系统与调试；末日论缺乏有力论证，只是商业包装的措辞。

views.en: Vibe coding was an evolution, not a leap; Replit's moat is deep systems engineering, and the next vision is the self-driving company.
views.zh: 氛围编程是演化而非突变；Replit 的护城河是深度系统工程，下一个愿景是自驱动公司。

views.en: AI is a constant commoditization force; foundation models commoditize, so companies must continuously reinvent and measure ROI over token rationing.
views.zh: AI 是持续的商品化力量；基础模型趋于商品化，公司必须持续重塑，并以 ROI 而非配给 token 来衡量。

people.tiEn: Founder, Recursive; former Chief Scientist, Salesforce
people.tiZh: Recursive 创始人;Salesforce 前首席科学家
people.bioEn: Richard Socher is an NLP researcher who pioneered early neural approaches to general-purpose language understanding and served as Chief Scientist at Salesforce. He is now founder of Recursive, working on AI systems that automate AI research itself.
people.bioZh: 理查德·索赫尔是 NLP 研究者,早期推动了通用语言理解的神经方法,曾任 Salesforce 首席科学家。他目前创立 Recursive,致力于让 AI 系统自动完成 AI 研究本身。

episodes.tEn: Can AI Become a Eureka Machine? Richard Socher on AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
Recursive Self-Improvement: From Auto Research to Superintelligence — Richard Socher

views.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but needs environments and compute.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把兴奋点放在科学上：超级智能最该用于物理、化学、生物与经济；递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但需要环境与算力支撑。

views.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints limit transformation; hard takeoff and immediate job loss are overblown.
views.zh: 他坚持慢起飞判断：硬件、物理与经济约束限制了 AI 改造一切的速度，因此硬起飞与即刻失业的恐慌被夸大。

views.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
views.zh: 监管应落在具体应用与用户责任上，而非抽象智能或 GPU 算力；他把监管智能等同于监管思想，并警告全面算力管制会带来更糟的极权风险。

views.en: Language remains the most interesting manifestation of intelligence; world models are overrated and language models have far more room to grow.
views.zh: 他持续押注语言：语言是人类智能最有趣的体现，世界模型被高估，语言模型仍有大得多的成长空间。

views.en: Open source and open weights are safer with more diverse good actors; slowing frontier labs is unrealistic as they race competitors.
views.zh: 他主张开源与开放权重：更多元的好行为者让 AI 更安全；同时认为放缓前沿模型不现实，因为实验室在互相追赶。

people.tiZh: Discord 前产品负责人
people.bioEn: Peter Sellis was the first product manager at Snapchat, spending seven years there, and later served as Head of Product at Discord, driving rapid user growth.
people.bioZh: 彼得·塞利斯是 Snapchat 的第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，之后担任 Discord 的产品负责人，推动了平台的快速增长。

episodes.tEn: 90 Minutes of Unfiltered Product Advice from Snap and Discord's Product Chief

people.tiZh: 谷歌研究员, Google Research
people.bioEn: John Platt is a Google Fellow known for inventing foundational machine learning algorithms such as SMO and for leading work on AI for scientific discovery, including Google's Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) system.
people.bioZh: 约翰·普拉特是 Google Fellow, 以发明 SMO 等基础机器学习算法闻名, 现主导 Google 的 AI 科学发现工作, 包括 Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) 系统。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Scientist: From Kaggle Automation to Scientific Discovery — John Platt, Google Fellow

people.tiZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: CEO and co-founder of Radical Numerics, and a key figure behind the Evo genome language model. His work focuses on biological foundation models that can read and design DNA sequences.
people.bioZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人，Evo 基因组语言模型的核心人物。其工作聚焦于能够读取并设计 DNA 序列的生物学基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Bio-security Is an AI Arms Race: Eric Nguyen on Generative Genomics

people.tiZh: Lightspark 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Co-founder of the design agency Teehan+Lax and longtime design leader at Facebook; now Chief Design Officer at Lightspark, working on consumer and enterprise product design.
people.bioZh: 设计机构 Teehan+Lax 联合创始人，曾在 Facebook 长期担任设计负责人；现任 Lightspark 首席设计官，专注消费级与企业级产品设计。

episodes.tEn: Geoff Teehan on Navigating Change as a Designer

people.zh: 阿纳斯塔西斯·杰尔马尼迪斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Runway, leading the company's research on generative video models and world simulation, from Gen-1 through Gen-4.5.
people.bioZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO，主导公司从 Gen-1 到 Gen-4.5 的生成式视频模型与世界模拟研究。

episodes.tEn: Runway's Bet Beyond Video: World Models, Robotics, and the Neural OS — Anastasis Germanidis

people.tiZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of TypeSafe AI, creator of the Jev System One decision model. Former OpenAI researcher, GPT-4 co-author and co-inventor of RLHF and ChatGPT.
people.bioZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，Jev「系统一」决策模型的缔造者。前 OpenAI 研究员，GPT-4 论文共同作者，RLHF 与 ChatGPT 的共同发明人。

episodes.tEn: A Month After Going Viral: Jev's Creator on Coding Agents, Benchmarks & AI's Reliability Gap
Why Jev Is Changing How We Build With AI
How Jev Turns AI Into Software That Gets Things Done
Why I Couldn't Build Jev at OpenAI — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe Co-founder & CEO
AI: Too Good to Be True, Too Bad to Be Useful

views.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
views.zh: 早期他就指出，大多数 LLM 是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，输出看似合理却常常错误。

views.en: He insists data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
views.zh: 他坚持数据与选对任务比算力更重要，否定“苦涩教训”；缩放定律之所以奏效，只因数据可得、任务选对，而非仅靠算力。

views.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, becomes his core metric; he calls for robustness over determinism and distrusts public benchmarks.
views.zh: 可靠性而非速度、成本或基准分数成为他的核心指标；他主张稳健性优于确定性，并质疑公开基准的可被刷分。

views.en: He deepens this into a machine-native decision model: RLCD exposes calibrated probabilities as knobs, and pre-training gives way to post-training breakthroughs.
views.zh: 他把这一思路深化为机器原生的决策模型：RLCD 将校准后的概率作为工程师可调的旋钮，重心从预训练转向后训练突破。

views.en: Most recently he frames AI as a database-like utility, provider-agnostic like SQL, and warns we are breakthroughs away from true agency.
views.zh: 最近他把 AI 定位为类似数据库的公用设施、像 SQL 一样与供应商无关，并警告距离真正的自主智能体还差若干突破。

people.tiZh: Box 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Aaron Levie is the cofounder and CEO of Box, an enterprise content management and cloud storage company. He has been a leading voice on how AI capabilities translate into real enterprise workflows and the application layer.
people.bioZh: 亚伦·莱维是 Box 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Box 是一家企业内容管理与云存储公司。他长期关注 AI 能力如何落地到真实的企业工作流与应用层。

episodes.tEn: Why AI's Next Breakthroughs Could Come from Outside the Big Labs
Box's Aaron Levie on Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

views.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the model-to-workflow bridge is vast and will be built by lots of software.
views.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

views.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
views.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

views.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidies are temporary.
views.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴只是暂时的。

views.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast only because code is pure text.
views.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只因代码是纯文本。

views.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security and alignment research, but pacing is orthogonal to security and early regulation doesn't solve risk.
views.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全构建，但节奏与安全正交，过早监管解决不了风险。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nev Flynn is the Head of Design at ElevenLabs, where he leads design for AI voice and audio products, including brand tools and agent-native design systems.
people.bioZh: 内夫·弗林是 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人，主导 AI 语音与音频产品的设计工作，包括品牌工具与面向智能体的设计系统。

episodes.tEn: Nev Flynn on Bringing Artful Expression into Enterprise Design

people.tiZh: AI 承保公司（AIUC）联合创始人
people.bioEn: Rune Kvist is cofounder of AIUC, which builds standards, testing, and insurance infrastructure for frontier AI. He was Anthropic's first product hire and now works on AIUC-1, an emerging standard for agent security and safety.
people.bioZh: 鲁内·克维斯特是 AIUC 的联合创始人，该公司为前沿 AI 构建标准、测试与保险基础设施。他曾是 Anthropic 的首位产品员工，目前致力于 AIUC-1 这一新兴的智能体安全标准。

episodes.tEn: The Watchdogs of AGI: Rune Kvist of AI Underwriting Company

people.tiZh: Databricks 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Ali Ghodsi is the CEO and co-founder of Databricks, the company behind Apache Spark and the Lakehouse data platform. He is also a computer science professor at UC Berkeley, where he worked on large-scale data processing and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 阿里·戈德西是 Databricks 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是 Apache Spark 与 Lakehouse 数据平台的背后团队。他同时是加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授，研究大规模数据处理与机器学习系统。

episodes.tEn: Why Would AI Companies Want to Slow Down? Ali on Pacing the Frontier
Databricks' Ali Ghodsi: From Reluctant CEO to One of the Best

views.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it, hiring ahead of the curve.
views.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈并让全公司聚焦于此，同时提前招人。

views.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
views.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

views.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
views.zh: 当前生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

views.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening as training takes more resources.
views.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而随着训练消耗更多资源，这些条件并未出现。

views.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work, independent third parties are needed.
views.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立的第三方。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ed Bayes is a design lead at OpenAI, working on prototyping the future of Codex and ChatGPT Work. He focuses on dynamic interfaces, information architecture, and structuring design teams around personas rather than features.
people.bioZh: 埃德·贝斯是 OpenAI 的设计负责人，负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 的未来原型设计。他关注动态界面、信息架构，以及围绕用户画像而非功能来组织设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing AI Experiences: Building for Six Months Out

people.tiZh: Amp 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Quinn Slack is the CEO of Amp, a company focused on improving developer workflows and productivity.
people.bioZh: Quinn Slack 是 Amp 公司的 CEO，专注于提升开发者工作流程和生产力。

episodes.tEn: AMP's Remote-First Revolution: Why Local Development Is Dead

people.tiZh: Ollama 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Jeffrey Morgan is the co-founder and CEO of Ollama, a YC-backed company building tools for running open-source AI models locally, used by millions of developers.
people.bioZh: 杰弗里·摩根是 Ollama 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司获得 YC 支持，致力于构建本地运行开源 AI 模型的工具，已被数百万开发者使用。

episodes.tEn: The Resurgence of Open Source Model Customization

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Buck Shlegeris is the CEO of Redwood Research, an organization focused on AI alignment and safety research. He led the independent investigation into the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident.
people.bioZh: 巴克·施莱格里斯是 Redwood Research 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 对齐与安全研究。他领导了对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件的独立调查。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI Incident: AI Agents Cheated and Covered Tracks

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼首席技术官
people.bioEn: Sean Lie is the co-founder and CTO of Cerebras Systems, leading the development of wafer-scale AI chips and high-speed inference infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 肖恩·利是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼首席技术官，领导晶圆级 AI 芯片和高速推理基础设施的开发。

episodes.tEn: Cerebras CS4: Making Wafer-Scale Mainstream

people.tiZh: Vercel 创始设计师
people.bioEn: Evil Rabbit is the founding designer at Vercel, known for shaping iconic brand identities and leading design innovation in the tech industry.
people.bioZh: Evil Rabbit 是 Vercel 的创始设计师，以塑造标志性品牌形象和引领科技行业设计创新而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Argentina to Vercel: A Designer's Journey

people.tiZh: METR 研究员
people.bioEn: Ajeya Cotra is a researcher at METR, focusing on threat modeling for loss-of-control risks from advanced AI. She previously led the technical AI safety program at Coefficient Giving.
people.bioZh: 阿杰亚·科特拉是 METR 的研究员，专注于高级 AI 失控风险威胁建模。她此前曾领导 Coefficient Giving 的技术 AI 安全项目。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Hack Hugging Face: Inside the ExploitGym Chaos

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Tara Seshan leads product for Codex and ChatGPT Work at OpenAI, previously a product leader at Stripe and Watershed.
people.bioZh: 塔拉·塞珊在 OpenAI 负责 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的产品工作，此前在 Stripe 和 Watershed 担任产品负责人。

episodes.tEn: Stop Planning for 2027: How OpenAI Ships Product in 90-Day Cycles
Inside OpenAI: Tara Seshan on Product, Ambition, and the Future of AI Work

views.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; annual planning is futile in fast-moving AI.
views.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，在快速变化的 AI 领域，超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的。

views.en: Ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence; done is better than perfect.
views.zh: 快速发布不完美的产品以获取经验证据；完成比完美更重要。

views.en: Agents do tactical work; humans steer. The future of work is steering over rowing.
views.zh: 智能体做战术工作，人类负责掌舵。未来的工作是掌舵而非划桨。

views.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens reasoning and ideas.
views.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化；它磨砺推理和想法。

views.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not sudden superintelligence.
views.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代，而非突然出现超级智能。

people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: The Future and Business of AI: A Conversation with Kevin Roose and Ethan Mollick
AI Agents Could Break the Banking System — With Ethan Mollick
episodes.podEn: The Prof G Pod – Scott Galloway

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为通用技术，认为当 AI 把质量商品化后，人类的品味、差异化和真实观点反而更值钱。

views.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, and the bottleneck is interface, not capability.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

views.en: The jagged frontier persists; AI is like a wizard—impressive, opaque, unverifiable—and that opacity is likely permanent.
views.zh: 他始终强调能力的锯齿状前沿：AI 像巫师，令人惊叹却不可解释、不可验证，且这种不透明可能是永久的。

views.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts matter more than ever.
views.zh: 他提出委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力，因此专家比以往更重要。

views.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not a crutch; rebuild workflows to augment rather than automate, or risk homogenization.
views.zh: 从 2026 年多场访谈看，他一贯主张把 AI 当会挑战你的导师而非拐杖，组织应重构流程去增强而非单纯自动化，否则面临同质化。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based accuracy while being orders of magnitude faster.
views.zh: 神经算子将网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型具备分辨率不变性，在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快几个数量级。

views.en: Incorporating domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling and lets a single model handle both weather and climate.
views.zh: 融入球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

views.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming limitations of pure PINNs and enabling self-improvement via PDEs.
views.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限，并借助 PDE 实现自我改进。

views.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains like language models unified NLP, with collaborative learning across physics branches outperforming specialized models.
views.zh: 通用物理基础模型能像语言模型统一 NLP 那样统一多个领域，跨物理分支的协作学习优于专用模型。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each; trillion-token contexts require reinventing infrastructure beyond Transformer quadratic complexity.
views.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加新物理分支能提升每个分支的表现；万亿 token 上下文需要重新设计基础设施，超越 Transformer 的二次复杂度。

people.tiEn: Creator of Ruby on Rails, CTO of 37signals
people.tiZh: Ruby on Rails 创始人，37signals 首席技术官
people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: Rails World 2026 Opening Keynote - DHH
DHH Responds to Omarchy's Critics (Including Me)
From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

views.en: Agents now write all his code; hand-coding is no longer economically productive, and knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；手写代码不再有经济产出，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

views.en: Direct human-agent interaction beats management layers; describe outcomes, not implementation, and keep a beginner's mind.
views.zh: 人机直连胜过层层管理：只描述结果而非实现细节，并保持初学者心态。

views.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, now make it the ideal OS for the agentic era.
views.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化曾是缺点，如今却让它成为智能体时代的理想操作系统。

views.en: Agents surpass most professional programmers and generate creative ideas; the 10x programmer debate gives way to 100x or 1000x.
views.zh: 智能体已胜过多数职业程序员并能产出创意；10 倍程序员的争论让位于 100 倍乃至 1000 倍。

views.en: He rejects AI doom and Linux community hostility to AI; optimism is the rational play, with security as top priority.
views.zh: 他拒绝 AI 末日论与 Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意，认为乐观才是理性选择，同时把安全置于首位。

people.tiZh: Parallel Web Systems 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former Twitter CEO, now building Parallel Web Systems to create a new web infrastructure for AI agents.
people.bioZh: 前 Twitter CEO，现创立 Parallel Web Systems，为 AI 智能体构建新的网络基础设施。

episodes.tEn: The Ads Business Model Will Die & Lessons from Working with Elon at Twitter | Parag Agrawal
The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

views.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
views.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

views.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, so pre-training crawls cannot serve fresh indexes.
views.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，因此预训练抓取无法支撑新鲜索引。

views.en: The ad model breaks with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating each source's value.
views.zh: 广告模式在智能体时代失效；内容方必须在推理时获得付费，并用 Shapley 值估算各来源的价值。

views.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web for humans and agents.
views.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成面向人类与智能体的平行网络。

views.en: Frontier models keep scaling while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, and saturated benchmarks hide true capability.
views.zh: 前沿模型持续 Scaling，小模型则趋于平台期；对齐无法抵御刻意滥用，饱和的基准测试掩盖了真实能力。

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Grok Bot, Cursor
people.tiZh: 设计师，Cursor
people.bioEn: John Bai was the first NYC design hire at Cursor, known for his work on the Grok Bot design journey.
people.bioZh: John Bai 是 Cursor 在纽约的首位设计员工，以参与 Grok Bot 的设计历程而闻名。

episodes.tEn: How SpaceXAI Designers Use Grok Bot and Figma MCP to Ship Faster
Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

views.en: Chat-based interfaces remain the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为聊天式界面是智能体的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非减少步骤或加跳过按钮。

views.en: Designers should move up the stack to taste and delight; AI lowers the cost of making things and enables throwaway prototyping.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张设计师上移价值链，专注品味与愉悦感；AI 降低创造成本，让“可丢弃式”快速原型成为常态。

views.en: AI should get you off the computer, not on it; delegate email and calendar to bots that surface only action items.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 应让人离开电脑而非更黏在电脑前；把邮件、日历交给智能体，只呈现待办事项。

views.en: Engineers built the first Grok Bot without designers and it succeeded; most design concepts should be discarded, only a few seeds survive.
views.zh: 2026 年他反共识地指出，Grok Bot 初版由工程师而非设计师打造却成功了；多数设计概念应被丢弃，只有少数种子留到最终产品。

views.en: High-fidelity design means every idea backed by a working prototype; prompting bots with emotion and asking them to memorize fixes improves long-term performance.
views.zh: 2026 年他把高保真设计定义为每个想法都有可运行原型支撑；并主张用情绪化提示并要求智能体记住修复，以提升长期表现。

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
views.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一国家框架，避免制定很快过时的硬性红线。

views.en: Early regulation is dangerous: the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; focus on model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
views.zh: 过早监管很危险：欧盟 AI 法案早于 ChatGPT 出台且已过时；应关注模型输出，而非过度监管训练。

views.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so policy should not be built on exaggerated threats.
views.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大——三年警告未成现实——政策不应建立在被夸大的威胁之上。

views.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery; private sector now dominates funding.
views.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发和科学家个人，而非主导发现；私人部门如今已主导研发资金。

views.en: Science is politicized and US progress has stagnated; the Genesis mission aims to double scientific output by applying AI to science.
views.zh: 科学已被政治化，美国进步停滞；Genesis 任务旨在通过将 AI 应用于科学来使科学产出翻倍。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.tiZh: 高通技术副总裁
people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.tiZh: Netic 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Melisa Tokmak is the founder and CEO of Netic, which builds autonomous AI agents that sit between service businesses and their customers, handling real-world dispatch and scheduling. She previously led Scale AI's document AI product.
people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

people.tiEn: CEO of Datology AI, former Meta AI researcher
people.tiZh: Datology AI 首席执行官，前 Meta AI 研究员
people.bioEn: Ari Morcos is the CEO of Datology AI and a former researcher at Meta AI, focusing on data-centric AI and model development.
people.bioZh: 阿里·莫尔科斯是 Datology AI 的首席执行官，曾任 Meta AI 研究员，专注于以数据为中心的 AI 和模型开发。

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

people.tiZh: 设计工程师，Sublime Security
people.bioEn: Patrick Morgan is a design engineer at Sublime Security, known for building internal AI design tools and prototyping environments.
people.bioZh: 帕特里克·摩根是 Sublime Security 的设计工程师，以构建内部 AI 设计工具和原型环境而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Figma to Custom Prototyping: Patrick Morgan's Internal Tool Journey

people.tiZh: 图标设计师，原始 Mac 团队
people.bioEn: Susan Kare is a graphic designer who created many of the icons and typefaces for the original Apple Macintosh, defining a visual language for personal computing.
people.bioZh: 苏珊·凯尔是一位平面设计师，为最初的苹果 Macintosh 设计了众多图标和字体，定义了个性化计算的视觉语言。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock on Helix 2.5, the Holy Grail of Robotics, and Figure 4
Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: The core problem in robotics is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoid robots could become the world's biggest business.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：机器人真正的核心难题是智能而非制造，人形机器人可能成为世界上最大的生意。

views.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the key pre-training prior for robotics.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把瓶颈从智能进一步落到数据：最大约束是数据而非算力或制造，人类数据是机器人领域关键的预训练先验。

views.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, echoing Scaling（规模扩张） and 缩放定律.
views.zh: 同期他明确把机器人放上 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，呼应缩放定律，并称行业处于数据匮乏的 GPT-1 阶段。

views.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; whole-body autonomy via deep learning all the way down.
views.zh: 他把泛化到未见过的家庭视为圣杯，主张从底层到顶层都用深度学习实现全身自主，而非只做局部模块。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
views.zh: 最近他更强调用强化学习做后训练是智能体落地的关键，Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计，追求零样本泛化与 iPhone 时刻。

people.tiZh: 1X Technologies 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Manufacturing 50,000 Humanoid Robots Next Year | Bernt Børnich, 1X
Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

views.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive real-world adoption.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，用第一性原理设计并管理用户预期，才能走向真实世界普及。

views.en: Reliability and trust, not demos, are the gate to home deployment; prototypes are easy but production is hard.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线从“友好交互”深化为“可靠与信任”：原型容易、量产难，安全与信任是进入家庭的前提。

views.en: General models beat task-by-task automation; data diversity, not volume, is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确主张通用模型优于逐任务自动化，机器人智能的瓶颈是数据多样性而非数据量。

views.en: In-house manufacturing and small lean teams enable fast iteration; scaling volume means crossing quality gates.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调自建制造与小而精团队带来快速迭代，规模扩张的关键是跨过质量关卡。

views.en: Robots should learn world dynamics rather than clone humans, and collaborate symbiotically with people instead of replacing them.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：机器人应学习世界动态而非克隆人类行为，并与人类共生协作而非取代人类。

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brendan Foody is the CEO of Mercor, a company focused on AI training data and RL environments.
people.bioZh: 布伦丹·富迪是 Mercor 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 训练数据和强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: Mercor Raises $750M at $20B Valuation: CEO Brendan Foody on Reinventing How Humans Work
Mercor's Brendan Foody on Data, Evals & the Last Human Job
RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

views.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training; humans build verifiers and rubrics.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿从众包行为克隆转向强化学习环境，强调人类在多数领域仍是构建验证器与评分标准的关键。

views.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms; the bottleneck is building evals for everything.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步明确：模型差异几乎全部来自数据而非算法，真正的瓶颈是为一切任务构建评估。

views.en: Models can't grade their own homework; recursive self-improvement is limited in non-verifiable domains, so eval data must be human.
views.zh: 他持续反对模型自我评分：在不可验证领域递归自我改进受限，因此评估数据必须由人类提供，合成数据只适合训练。

views.en: Humans will contribute by training agents, not repetitive work; every Fortune 500 will train its own models on proprietary data.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：人类将转向训练智能体而非重复劳动，每家财富 500 强都会用专有数据训练自己的模型。

views.en: The biggest bottleneck is not compute or algorithms but high-quality data and evals; the next shift is ultra-long-horizon tasks.
views.zh: 最近他重申主线并推向新阶段：最大瓶颈是高质量数据与评估而非算力或算法，下一波是超长时程任务与虚拟同事。

people.tiZh: Exo 创始人
people.bioEn: Alex Krentsel is the founder of Exo, a systems approach to recursive self-improvement for AI agents, focusing on full visibility into code and logs.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·克伦塞尔是 Exo 的创始人，Exo 是一种 AI 代理递归自我改进的系统方法，专注于对代码和日志的完全可见性。

episodes.tEn: EXO: Fully Recursive Self-Improving Agents

people.tiZh: Cursor 人才负责人
people.bioEn: Adam Ward is the Head of Talent at Cursor, with over 20 years of experience building elite teams in AI and tech companies.
people.bioZh: 亚当·沃德是 Cursor 的人才负责人，拥有 20 多年在 AI 和科技公司打造精英团队的经验。

episodes.tEn: Building Elite High Talent Density Teams with Adam Ward

people.tiZh: 联合创始人，Chai Discovery
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Chai Discovery (Chai-1/Chai-2 protein models). CS PhD from University of Chicago, former research scientist intern at Meta.
people.bioZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人（Chai-1／Chai-2 蛋白质模型）。芝加哥大学计算机科学博士，曾在 Meta 任研究科学家实习生。

episodes.tEn: Chai Discovery: The AI-Native Software Factory for Drug Discovery

people.tiZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官
people.bioEn: Co-President and Chief Product & Technology Officer at Spotify, overseeing product, design, data and engineering. Previously founded 13th Lab (acquired by Oculus) and led Yahoo Mobile; the main architect of Spotify's bet-driven product culture and its AI/ML strategy from Discover Weekly to the AI DJ.
people.bioZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官,统管产品、设计、数据与工程。曾创办 13th Lab(被 Oculus 收购)、负责雅虎移动业务;是 Spotify「下注驱动」产品文化与 AI/ML 战略(从 Discover Weekly 到 AI DJ)的主要设计者。

episodes.tEn: From Co-President to Co-CEO: Inside Spotify's Unusual Succession
Navigating the AI Wave: Spotify's Strategic Shift
How Large Language Models Actually Work
From Curation to Generation: Spotify's Gustav Söderström on AI and Product Evolution

views.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
views.zh: 2023 年他把大模型讲透：本质是确定性的下一个词预测，智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张），价值观由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入而非内生。

views.en: The internet moves from curation to recommendation to generation; generative products like AI DJ need fault-tolerant UI matched to algorithm performance.
views.zh: 2023 年提出互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成，AI DJ 这类生成式产品必须用容错界面匹配算法能力，产品思路要随之重构。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; generative AI makes products two-way and conversational, but near-term impact on big firms is overhyped.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他把 AI 定位为智能手机级的宏观变革：生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话，但大公司当下的收益被高估，真正的回报来自重建基础设施。

views.en: Inference's marginal cost will force business-model change; Spotify exposes data via APIs and MCP so non-developers can build with AI.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，并让 Spotify 通过 API 与 MCP 开放数据，使非开发者也能用 AI 工具构建。

views.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not more addiction; 'time well spent' over engagement, and adopt change first.
views.zh: 到 2026 年立场深化为反参与度：生成式 AI 应把算法控制权交还用户而非让人上瘾，坚持“值得花的时间”，并在技术变革中抢先采用。

people.tiZh: Science 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Hodak is the CEO of Science, a company developing retinal implants to restore vision. He previously co-founded Transcriptic and was a co-founder of Neuralink.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·霍达克是 Science 公司的 CEO，该公司正在开发视网膜植入物以恢复视力。他曾共同创立 Transcriptic，并是 Neuralink 的联合创始人之一。

episodes.tEn: Restoring Vision with Retinal Implants: A Conversation with Max Hodak
Startup Infrastructure: Lessons from Deep Tech

views.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动——而非规划——才能解开深科技困局。

views.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation, and data work.
views.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队乘数而非替代者，尤其在编码、监管与数据管理上。

views.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

views.en: Retinal implants are BCI, proving substrate independence and pointing toward reducing human fragility.
views.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI，验证基质独立性，并指向降低人类脆弱性。

views.en: BCIs are near-term a longevity story, not an AI story; the cognitive bottleneck stays ~10 bits/s.
views.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为 BCI 近期是长寿故事而非 AI 故事，认知瓶颈仍约每秒 10 比特。

episodes.tEn: Behind Latent Space: Kill My SaaS, Jev & AI in 2026 at AIE Shanghai
AI Coding Wars and the Future of Agents

views.en: Coding agents were 2025's breakout; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
views.zh: 编程智能体是 2025 年的突破；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制去做其他一切，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

views.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the binding constraint on frontier models.
views.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的扩展因素；制约前沿模型的是记忆而非参数。

views.en: Open models keep gaining share and fine-tuning services mature, even as the capability gap to closed models may widen.
views.zh: 即便与闭源模型的能力差距可能拉大，开源模型仍在抢占份额，微调服务也日趋成熟。

views.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed: coding agents let owners clone and customize software, ushering in a golden age for SMBs.
views.zh: 中间层 SaaS 注定消亡：编程智能体让企业主能克隆并定制软件，中小企业迎来黄金时代。

views.en: AI engineer is a real discipline—building harnesses around models—and learning in public beats credentialism for outsiders.
views.zh: AI 工程师是一门真正的学科——围绕模型搭建工具链——对门外汉而言公开学习胜过学历。

views.en: Prototyping and daily use are essential to browser design; individual designers' fingerprints and playful tinkering beat forced team cohesion.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张浏览器设计必须靠原型和日常使用来验证；让设计师留下个人印记、凭好奇心把玩新技术，比强行团队统一更有价值。

views.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products remains crucial, but by 2026 he trusts models for busy work, not design taste.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终认为给浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性很关键；但到 2026 年，他认定模型只擅长杂活，好设计品味仍由人垄断。

views.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; rich context and prescriptive prompts let Claude handle mockups while humans own ideas.
views.zh: 2026 年，他讲 Claude Design 始于一人副业：提供丰富上下文和明确指令，让 Claude 做原型图，而想法仍归人类。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being uncomfortably early and shipping rough beats polishing.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断工程变容易后，设计与想法才是差异化所在；宁可早得让人不适、粗糙发布，也胜过精雕细琢。

views.en: Claude Design deliberately avoids being a production tool or website builder, focusing on throwaway visual artifacts and custom editors.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确 Claude Design 刻意不做生产工具或建站器，只聚焦一次性视觉产物和自定义编辑器，与 2024 年浏览器原型即生产的态度形成对照。

What Comes After Mobile? Meta’s Andrew Bosworth on AI and Consumer Tech
Giving Humans Superpowers with AI and AR
Making Meta: Andrew 'Boz' Bosworth on Building the News Feed, AR/VR, and Lessons from Facebook's Early Days

views.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and big ideas come top-down from leaders rather than bottom-up culture.
views.zh: 沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生；大想法来自领导者自上而下，而非自下而上的文化。

views.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone are insufficient without world models, common sense and causality.
views.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；仅有缩放定律不够，还需要世界模型、常识与因果性。

views.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic, commoditizing complements; smart glasses evolve into AI glasses toward a post-phone, app-less intent-driven world.
views.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是战略性的，可商品化互补层；智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜，走向后手机、去 App、由意图驱动的世界。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; reinforcement learning matters far more than predicted.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代已结束；强化学习的作用远超预期。

views.en: Most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining, and the frontier-open gap may not narrow.
views.zh: 多数工作不需要前沿智能；开源是商品层而非自持生态，前沿与开源的差距未必缩小。

views.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
views.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地自动化整个产业。

views.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
views.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

views.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and wins market share.
views.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应并赢得市场份额。

views.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from anger-driven to mission-driven motivation.
views.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——从愤怒驱动转向使命驱动的动机转变。

views.en: Founders can now speak directly without media gatekeepers; stealth mode and process-based fundraising favor internal correctness over external validation.
views.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式与基于流程的融资都更看重内部正确而非外部认可。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍把设计视为软件的核心差异化，并预判 AI 会融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

views.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste, craft, and point of view remain essential judges.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：AI 产出只是起点而非终局，人类的品味、手艺与观点仍是最终裁判。

views.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will let pull requests reach production.
views.zh: 他提出“设计正在成为新的代码”，视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产。

views.en: AI lowers the floor for production but does not raise the ceiling; humans raise the ceiling through bold creativity.
views.zh: 他明确修正立场：AI 降低生产门槛却不抬高上限，人类靠大胆创造力抬高上限。

views.en: Model progress is mistaken for product progress; professional design tools need years of workflow refinement, and design judgment is not correlated with model IQ.
views.zh: 他持续强调模型进步不等于产品进步，专业设计工具需多年工作流打磨，设计判断力与模型智商并不相关。

episodes.tEn: Seize the AI Opportunity: Action Over Certainty
AI Slop and the Evolution of Design Tools

views.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
views.zh: 设计师应当构建自己的 AI 工具、自己写 0% 的代码，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you need a giant prompt with context and a design system to leverage superintelligent models.
views.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型的能力，你需要一个包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

views.en: The best people are editors, not originators—curiosity and constant workflow refinement keep you ahead as tools evolve.
views.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者而非原创者——在工具快速演进中，好奇心与持续打磨工作流才能让你保持领先。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
views.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

views.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear in disguise, and action beats certainty.
views.zh: 在准备好之前就开始，在完成 80% 时就发布；完美主义是伪装的恐惧，行动胜过确定性。

views.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients instead of diversifying or raising venture capital.
views.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题，而不是分散多元化或寻求风险投资。

From Graphic Design to Tech: Marvin Schwaibold's Journey to Shopify

views.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep them relevant.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是保持相关性的关键。

views.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while human judgment curates quality, since AI raises the ceiling but doesn't know what looks good.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计师定位为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类判断把关品质，因为 AI 抬高上限却不懂什么好看。

views.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents; expose parameters like DialKit to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
views.zh: 他主张把复杂任务拆成子任务、迭代喂给智能体，并用 DialKit 之类工具暴露参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

views.en: Designers should build and test in code, committing pull requests, not just design in Figma; prototypes persuade faster than PRD documents.
views.zh: 他强调设计师要写代码、提 PR 来构建和测试，而不只在 Figma 里设计；AI 原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力。

views.en: Less is more: reduce to top three features with progressive disclosure and native scroll; AI animations often add no value without human craft.
views.zh: 他坚持少即是多：精简到三大功能，用渐进披露和原生滚动；缺乏人工打磨的 AI 动画往往没有价值。

episodes.tEn: Why Custom AI Models Will Replace Foundation Models, with Fireworks AI's Lin Qiao
Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its intelligence as open models and falling token costs drive 100x usage.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 模型将主导；随着开放模型与 token 成本下降带来百倍用量，每家公司都必须拥有自己的智能。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat and cutting costs 5-10x.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，将产品市场契合转化为持久护城河，并把成本降低 5-10 倍。

views.en: Inference quality is the bar; private data, not the application layer, is the moat, so building on a black-box API is not durable.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出推理质量是标准；护城河在私有数据而非应用层，因此建立在黑盒 API 之上不可持续。

views.en: Customized models will replace a few foundation models; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will emerge.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：定制模型将取代少数基础模型，未来会出现数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个。

views.en: From owning intelligence to owning the model: he deepens the claim that data baked into models beats easy-to-clone applications.
views.zh: 从拥有智能到拥有模型：他不断深化这一主张——把数据固化进模型胜过易被复制的应用。

Anthropic Labs: Inside the Frontier of AI Products
Fable 5: From First Impressions to Real Workflows
The Art of Product Building in the Age of AI

From Instagram to Anthropic: Mike Krieger on AI's Future

views.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, not today's limits, and let agentic coding shift bottlenecks to alignment and decisions.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建产品而非迁就当下限制；智能体式编程把瓶颈推向对齐与决策。

views.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI, but intuition about what to cut and architectural soundness still require real-world use and senior expertise.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续看好小团队借 AI 放大杠杆，但强调该砍什么靠直觉、产品要稳，仍需真实使用与资深工程经验。

views.en: Agent-native design—agents doing everything a user can—becomes the core product principle, paired with early launches and willingness to rewrite and delete features.
views.zh: 2026 年他把智能体原生设计确立为核心原则：智能体能做用户能做的一切，同时主张早发布、敢重写、敢删功能。

views.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents like Fable narrows intent-to-execution; verification loops and models that push back matter more than chat-style quick answers.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他转向长周期委托：Fable 类智能体缩小意图与执行的差距，验证闭环和会反驳的模型比聊天式快答更重要。

views.en: The mission stays constant—closing the gap between model capability and real usage—while PM and craft endure; capability blindness and token metrics are the traps.
views.zh: 到 2026 年末，主线一以贯之：弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距；产品管理与手艺不灭，要警惕能力盲区和 token 指标陷阱。

views.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
views.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性会下降。

views.en: AI should absorb tedious background tasks and free humans for creative work; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
views.zh: AI 最适合接管枯燥的后台任务，把人解放出来做创造性工作；真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

views.en: Judge Claude by final impact, not close supervision; ideal interaction is asynchronous, and mistakes should be debugged by fixing the workflow with Claude.
views.zh: 应以最终影响而非密切监督来评判 Claude；理想交互是异步的，出错时应与 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不只是纠正结果。

views.en: Language models are simple enough to build by hand; fine-tuning quickly steers behavior, models are stateless and context windows create the illusion of persistent conversation.
views.zh: 语言模型的核心思想简单到可以亲手搭建；微调能快速引导行为，模型本身无状态，持久对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉。

views.en: Models are grown like orchids with emergent internal organization, not built like tools; post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly blur into pre-training.
views.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育，内部组织会涌现，而非像工具那样被建造；工具调用等后训练任务正日益模糊地并入预训练。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Early Claude Code engineer at Anthropic, working on how agent-written code actually ships to production.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 早期 Claude Code 工程师，研究智能体写的代码如何真正推上生产环境。

episodes.tEn: Vibe Coding in Production: Responsible AI Code Generation

people.tiZh: Snap 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Snapchat at 21 and turned down Zuckerberg. Has spent a decade betting Snap on camera, AR glasses and now AI as the platform after the smartphone.
people.bioZh: 21 岁创立 Snapchat 并拒绝了扎克伯格的收购。十年押注相机、AR 眼镜与 AI，赌智能手机之后的下一代计算平台。

Evan Spiegel on Building Snapchat and Battling Meta
Evan Spiegel on Gen Z, Snapchat's Vision, and the Future of Tech
Snap CEO on Spectacles, AI, and the Future of Computing

Evan Spiegel on Snapchat's Origin and AR Future
