views.zh: 2023 年他主张开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全，并认为单靠 Scaling 大语言模型未必通向 AGI，未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

views.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the bottleneck; intelligence can be separated from agency.
views.zh: 2024 年他借 Llama 3 强调 Scaling 之快，把开源视为防止权力集中的手段，并首次点出能源将成为 Scaling 的瓶颈，同时坚持智能可与意识、能动性分离。

views.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and creativity; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises rather than kills human work demand.
views.zh: 2025 年他把叙事转向“人人拥有超级智能”，强调开源模型确立行业标准，物理基础设施与能源仍是 Scaling 瓶颈，并认为短期内 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

views.en: Distributed AI and open source are the safe path; alignment becomes the top next capability; personal agents need privacy architecture and discretion.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确分布式 AI 与开源才是安全路径，把对齐提升为最重要的下一项能力，并要求个人智能体具备隐私架构与分寸感。

views.en: Scaling compute may suffice for AGI without architecture breakthroughs; glasses become the next platform; AI plus world models accelerate biology.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步认为 Scaling 算力或许足以实现 AGI、无需架构突破，智能眼镜成为下一代平台，并以世界模型加速生物学，主线始终是开源、分布式与个人赋权。

people.tiZh: 微软董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, having been CEO since 2014 and adding the chairman role in 2021. Under his leadership Microsoft pivoted to cloud computing and became a leading force in AI, notably through its partnership with OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 萨提亚·纳德拉是微软的董事长兼 CEO,自 2014 年出任 CEO,并于 2021 年兼任董事长。在他的带领下,微软转向云计算,并通过与 OpenAI 的合作成为 AI 领域的领军力量。

episodes.tEn: Satya Nadella on AI Security, Alignment Limits, and Microsoft's Succession
Satya Nadella on Copilot, the AI Backlash, and Microsoft's Future
Satya Nadella: AI as the Hill-Climbing Machine
Satya Nadella on AI Ecosystem Strategy and Frontier Models

views.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 AI 不是技术而是企业的未来，每家企业都应构建自己的爬坡机器来积累 token 资本。

views.en: The agent era expands TAM beyond cloud; long-running agents need auditability, observability, and security governance.
views.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 9 月，他深化智能体观点：智能体时代将 TAM 扩大到云之外，但长时运行智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

views.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
views.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确 Scaling（规模扩张）有效，但对齐不会自然到来，拟人化 AI 可能阻碍对齐。

views.en: Alignment may never be solved; treat powerful models as insider threats and build control layers outside the model.
views.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他进一步认为对齐可能永远无法解决，应把强大模型视为内部威胁，在模型外构建控制层。

views.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy.
views.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他转向术语与战略：超级智能比 AGI（通用人工智能）更准确，落后前沿六个月是明智策略。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: Andrew Feldman on Building Cerebras and the Future of Chips
The Largest Chip Ever and the Speed of AI
AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Fast inference is the real bottleneck for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market, and speed enables new business models.
views.zh: 快速推理才是 AI 落地的真正瓶颈；慢速 AI 没有市场，速度会催生全新商业模式。

views.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference ~2500x faster than GPUs; CUDA's moat is eroding.
views.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，推理比 GPU 快约 2500 倍；CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解。

views.en: Inference demand exploded as models got smart enough; data center capacity, not chip supply, is now the main constraint.
views.zh: 随着模型足够聪明，推理需求爆发；如今主要约束是数据中心容量，而非芯片供给。

views.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation means controlling chip, system, software and API.
views.zh: 对抗巨头需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；激进创新意味着掌控芯片、系统、软件与 API。

views.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power grid and open models, not chips.
views.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多；中国的优势是电网与开源模型，而非芯片。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Needs Your Company's Context
Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Early in the AI revolution, enterprise adoption is tiny; execution and customer trust matter more than competition.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 革命仍处极早期，企业采用率微不足道；对创业公司而言，执行力和客户信任比竞争更重要。

views.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open-source models can handle 90% of tasks, shifting inference to open source.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调成本是企业头号关切，开源模型已能处理 90%的企业任务，推理将大规模转向开源。

views.en: Context, not models, is the key; 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit and must be captured by a context engine.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把主线深化为“上下文而非模型才是关键”，企业 80-90%的知识是隐性的，需由上下文引擎承接。

views.en: Use multiple models per task to cut cost; Glean stays replaceable and headless rather than locking enterprises in.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张按任务选用多模型以降本，并让 Glean 保持可替换、无头化，而非锁定企业。

views.en: AI should augment work with negligible marginal cost; enterprise memory and agent learnings belong to the enterprise.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 应以近乎零边际成本增强人类工作，且企业记忆与智能体学习成果应归企业所有。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, turning biology into an engineering discipline with programmable cells.
views.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，把生物学变成可编程细胞的工程学科。

views.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so Scaling（规模扩张）remains the bottleneck.
views.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，Scaling 仍是瓶颈。

views.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI-designed personalized medicine could reach near 100% efficacy with zero side effects.
views.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 设计的个性化医疗有望接近 100% 疗效且零副作用。

views.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal via partial reprogramming needs engineering plus AI to handle complexity.
views.zh: 8-10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度；通过部分重编程逆转衰老需要工程手段加 AI 来应对复杂性。

views.en: Trust superintelligence almost fully for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
views.zh: 医疗决策应几乎完全信任超级智能；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality data and human evals are crucial; benchmarks are misleading and can be gamed. RL environments are the next post-training stage.
views.zh: 2025 年强调高质量数据和人类评估至关重要；基准测试具有误导性且可被操纵。强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

views.en: AGI is likely a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction. Vibe coding is overhyped.
views.zh: 2025 年认为 AGI 可能还需十年；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。氛围编程被过度炒作。

views.en: Models diverge by lab objective functions; no single model will rule. Companies should train their own models aligned with unique theses.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年指出模型因实验室目标函数而分化；不会有单一模型统治。公司应训练符合自身独特论点的模型。

views.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety over accuracy. RAG improves reliability, but omission is a major risk.
views.zh: 2026 年在医学领域，AI 幻觉使人类判断至关重要；安全优于准确。RAG 提高可靠性，但遗漏是主要风险。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simile CEO Joon Sung Park on Predicting Human Behavior with 85%+ Accuracy
Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; early focus on small-scale societies like Smallville.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；早期聚焦于 Smallville 等小规模社会模拟。

views.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike LLMs that only continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，不同于仅续写提示的 LLM；AGI 可能是一个由专业智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

views.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调模拟应建模人类价值观与偏见，而非超级理性智能；合成小组将在三年内规模超过人类小组。

views.en: Post-training with RCT data improves behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation models 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior, not self-reported attitudes.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出用 RCT 数据后训练将行为预测提升至 85%准确率；模拟应建模实际行为的“暗知识”，而非自我报告的态度。

views.en: Vision expands to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems; simulation is a tool for shaping the future, with market far larger than research.
views.zh: 2026 年，他的愿景扩展至模拟 80 亿人解决棘手问题；模拟是塑造未来的工具，其市场远大于市场研究。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: A Worm With 302 Neurons Inspired Their Architecture — Ramin Hasani, Liquid AI
Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and hardware-in-the-loop architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把效率当作研究基石：用液态神经网络与硬件在环的架构搜索，在最少参数、最低功耗下最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的端侧原生基础模型。

views.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures like transformers at scale.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持：注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但小型专用模型用更简单的门控卷积即可；缩放定律表明大规模下无偏架构（如 Transformer）占优。

views.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias in architecture design with systematic search.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：困惑度等代理指标会误导，必须在真实下游任务与硬件上评估；并用系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人为偏见。

views.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms—RL, Bayesian inference—and its intelligence per watt; new learning paradigms, not just architectures, are needed.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：当前 AI 缺少大脑那样的多样学习算法（强化学习、贝叶斯推理）与每瓦智能，需要新的学习范式而不只是新架构。

views.en: Regulation should be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty and on-device privacy.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向政策：监管应自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 方案是监管俘获，开放权重模型则让企业保有数据主权与端侧隐私。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 在数学上的进展靠的是可验证性与可“磨”性（并行 rollout），而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已够用。

views.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, with human framing still better for learning.
views.zh: 同年他进一步认为，AI 在数学中的角色正从定理证明转向策展与解释，而人类框架对学习仍更优。

views.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
views.zh: 他同时强调，AI 的数学成果常缺失对人类先前工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

views.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding and relational teaching roles remain stable.
views.zh: 他判断数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解与关系性的教学角色仍将稳定。

views.en: Next benchmark: AI generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving Millennium Problems may not yield direct economic value.
views.zh: 他提出下一个基准是 AI 生成有趣的猜想与定义；而解决千禧年难题未必直接转化为经济价值。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Competing with frontier labs is not that hard; they cannot capture all customers, so founders should focus.
views.zh: 2026 年，与前沿模型实验室竞争并不那么难，它们无法俘获所有客户，创始人应专注。

views.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it, leaving room to improve.
views.zh: 2026 年，对代码的深度理解仍关键；AI 编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解，仍有改进空间。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
views.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
views.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而不仅仅是扩大算力。

views.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'; more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale.
views.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”问题；即使达到 1000 万规模，更多词元反而降低准确率。

views.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights.
views.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models for every individual or team.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个个人或团队定制的众多个性化模型。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers.
views.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆。

views.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost considerations.
views.zh: 由于推理成本考量，模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍。

views.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; low precision is far more efficient than expected.
views.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；低精度的效率远超预期。

views.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits.
views.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但存在质量限制。

views.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory enable deterministic latency.
views.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 的拼接；脉动阵列和暂存器内存可实现确定性延迟。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, xAI (Grok Imagine); ex-NVIDIA (Cosmos)
people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.tiEn: Researcher, Google; PhD student, Cornell (continual learning)
people.tiZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔博士生（持续学习）
people.bioEn: Researcher at Google and PhD student at Cornell, working on continual learning and new sequence-model architectures (Nested Learning, Titans).
people.bioZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔大学博士生，研究持续学习与新型序列模型架构（Nested Learning、Titans）。

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.tiZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员
people.bioEn: Founding researcher at Sakana AI, working at the intersection of large language models and evolutionary methods (e.g. Shinka Evolve).
people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Jensen Huang's Exit Could Reshape the AI Industry Forever
Can AI Infrastructure Keep Growing Exponentially?
Which GPU Clouds Are Actually Good? ClusterMAX 3.0
AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Scaling's binding constraint is the semiconductor supply chain, especially ASML EUV; older GPUs gain value as inference demand grows.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV；随着推理需求上升，旧 GPU 反而更值钱。

views.en: Inference will become one of the world's largest markets; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth, not raw bits, drive gains.
views.zh: 到 2026 年年中，他把重心转向推理：推理将成为全球最大市场之一；硬件软件协同设计与内存带宽（而非单纯位数）才是性能关键。

views.en: AI spend plateaus as usage matures, but compute stays scarce; persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他判断 AI 支出随使用进入稳态而趋平，但算力仍稀缺；作为同事的持久智能体将驱动下一波采用。

views.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs out-earn hardware, and inference providers keep ~60% margins, shifting value capture toward labs.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 至 10 月，他深化判断：算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，价值捕获从硬件转向实验室，推理服务商仍保有约 60% 毛利。

views.en: AI capex near 5-6% of US GDP must decelerate on capital constraints; Nvidia's moat erodes as China diversifies and CUDA weakens.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 10 至 11 月，他警告 AI 资本开支已近美国 GDP 的 5-6%，将因资本约束而减速；随着中国多元化与 CUDA 护城河削弱，英伟达优势正在松动。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Instincts are right 95% of the time but ideas are wrong 75%; use Proven, Better, New and kill hope early.
views.zh: 直觉有 95%的正确率，但具体想法有 75%是错的；用“已验证、更好、全新”框架，并尽早掐灭不切实际的希望。

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely arrives around 2029.
views.zh: 消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”，却也是最大的机会；真正的革命大概要到 2029 年前后才到来。

views.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
views.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品里，而不是事后才补的附加项。

views.en: AI coding tools speed prototyping, but fast testing and failing is still not widely practiced.
views.zh: AI 编程工具加快了原型制作，但快速测试、快速失败仍未成为普遍实践。

views.en: Founder mode and early micromanagement beat waiting for a lightning-bolt idea; keep control and test relentlessly.
views.zh: 创始人模式与早期微观管理胜过等待灵光一现的想法；保持控制权，并持续不断地测试。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
views.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling 正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的架构。

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
views.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本更无损。

views.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models.
views.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，或许永远推不出牛顿定律；学界应追求古怪想法与新算法，而非只做 Scaling。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; language alone won't yield world understanding, so new model types are needed.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；仅靠语言无法产生世界理解，因此需要新的模型类型。

views.en: World models span planners, simulators, and renderers in the POMDP loop; a unified system will combine all three, with consistency from data and millions of tokens of context.
views.zh: 世界模型在 POMDP 循环中分为规划器、模拟器与渲染器；未来统一系统将三者合一，一致性来自数据，且需数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: Jerry Tworek on Building AI That Learns On the Fly and Challenging Transformers
The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 useful, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
views.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得有用，而 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling 预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的环节。

views.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning; architecture, not just scaling, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习上存在局限；架构而非单纯的 Scaling 才是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

views.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is unlikely to be optimal; small teams with agents will drive frontier research.
views.zh: 大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但 Transformer 不太可能是最优架构；小团队借助智能体将推动前沿研究。

views.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, and architecture research is undervalued as we head toward a post-labor society.
views.zh: 微调效率低下；模型应即时学习，随着我们迈向 post-labor 社会，架构研究的价值被严重低估。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: Why AlphaFold Didn't Solve Protein Folding: Data, Scaling, and the Future of Bioscience
From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
views.zh: 2024 年他主张 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜，而非窄应用；并用硬性评测逼模型泛化而非记忆。

views.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and post-training RL, not LLM shortcuts, push AI beyond human data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初，他强调 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与后训练强化学习才是超越人类数据之路，LLM 只是捷径。

views.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust and scalable, embedded in regulation and even protein design.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向水印：必须不可感知、抗攻击、可规模化，并嵌入监管乃至蛋白质设计，替代失效的文本检测器。

views.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where compute and data help, and curate data coverage.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）观：缩放定律并非处处成立，要找到算力与数据起作用的区间，数据覆盖比数量更重要。

views.en: Protein folding is not solved; dynamics, function and design remain open, and interpretability is in the eye of the beholder.
views.zh: 最近他纠正 AlphaFold 叙事：蛋白质折叠并未解决，动力学、功能与设计仍开放，可解释性也因人而异。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: Reflection AI's Ioannis on Open-Weight Models and the Future of AI Agents
From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

views.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo carry into agents; RL with self-generated and synthetic data pushes past the human-data wall.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划一脉相承；强化学习靠自生成与合成数据突破人类数据墙。

views.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment; digital AGI will arrive well before embodied AGI.
views.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻；数字 AGI（通用人工智能）会远早于具身 AGI 到来。

views.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment; cost per task, not per token, becomes the efficiency metric.
views.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向部署落地；衡量效率的指标从每 token 成本变为每任务成本。

views.en: Open-weight models are the safer path; enterprises want AI sovereignty over data, model, cost and safety.
views.zh: 开放权重模型是更安全的路径；企业要的是对数据、模型、成本与安全的 AI 主权。

views.en: Superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible.
views.zh: 不需要超级智能，客户只要可靠的普通智能；完美沙箱不可能，因此对齐必不可少。

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

views.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调：扩展一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，这一认识是他较晚才领悟的。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning and personalization; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable without prior training data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：语言集成能提升表征、推理与个性化；无需先验训练数据，也能实现跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化。

views.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; partnering with OEMs avoids costly retrofits and enables scalable deployment.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的部署立场一贯：带内置传感器的大众消费车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势；与 OEM 合作可避免昂贵的改装，实现可扩展部署。

views.en: Safety is paramount with minimal-risk maneuvers as a third option; the trolley problem is theoretical, and camera-only needs radar and lidar beyond human level.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他对安全的立场持续深化：最小风险操作始终是第三种选择，电车难题只是理论演练；纯视觉可达人类水平，但要超越人类安全仍需雷达与激光雷达。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
views.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利切入：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低，而未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学习，从而塑造人机关系。

views.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化为：模型需要的是帮助其理解自身新颖处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；模型应有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

views.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确地指出：Claude 的性格由训练数据与微调塑造，却缺乏真实世界经验，因而具有孩童般的独特属性。

views.en: The constitution guides behavior through training; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出：宪法通过训练引导行为，但随着模型能力增强，应减少显式指导、留出更多判断空间；这更接近德性伦理而非规则遵循。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability and public engagement.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出反共识判断：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳、损害模型的判断力；同时，对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明是问责与公众参与的关键。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training with synthetic data and RL breaks the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，靠合成数据与强化学习做后训练，突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
views.zh: 2025 年她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生。

views.en: Post-training stays subjective, driven by human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了“后训练主观”的判断：依赖人类判断，需要多元基准衡量创造力与情商。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous rather than fixed.
views.zh: 2026 年她指出前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，基准必须持续演进而非固定不变。

views.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models.
views.zh: 2026 年她主张单一模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，更多公司应训练自有模型以保留独特知识。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏，让复利在各方面累积。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用，而智能体使开发商品化，纯软件变得不可投资。

views.en: Happiness is a skill and a choice; desire is a contract to be unhappy; true learning happens through action, not passive reading.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：幸福是一种技能和选择，欲望是让自己不快乐的契约；真正的学习来自行动而非被动阅读。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年他仍认为 AI 不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

views.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage: documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调 PRD 没有死，媒介要匹配阶段：文档求清晰，原型做测试。

views.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base connecting other tools.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 模型增加代码复杂度，需要更擅长删代码的模型；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的家园，而非单体超级应用。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need real-world experience, not just internet data.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 需要真实世界经验，而不仅是互联网数据。

views.en: LLMs act as operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk.
views.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

views.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with RL for low-level control.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作，RL 用于低层控制。

views.en: Simulation and synthetic data are key to scaling embodied agents, enabling parallel training and safe exploration.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调仿真和合成数据是扩展具身智能体的关键，能实现并行训练和安全探索。

views.en: The data bottleneck in robotics demands synthetic data and world models; a simple end-to-end model is key to robot foundation models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出机器人领域的数据瓶颈需要合成数据和世界模型来解决；简单的端到端模型是构建机器人基础模型的关键。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data beating specialists.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，测试时推理与汇聚多实验室机器人数据可超越专用模型。

views.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law: generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, and a data flywheel must scale the right diverse embodied data.
views.zh: 机器人尚处缩放定律之前：泛化而非演示才是核心挑战，数据飞轮必须扩张正确的多样化具身数据。

views.en: Start from robot data, then add human video—not the reverse; prior knowledge beats learning from scratch, and safety comes from pre-training common sense.
views.zh: 应先从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，而非相反；先验知识优于从零学习，安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: David Silver & Lasse Espeholt on Building a Superlearner for the Age of Experience
From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

views.en: AI must move from learning on human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, experience is renewable.
views.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据有限，经验可再生。

views.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they distill human knowledge and cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data.
views.zh: LLM 是浅层解法：它们蒸馏人类知识，无法发现超出人类数据的新知识。

views.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance; simple rewards in complex environments produce emergent complexity.
views.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明从经验学习可达超人表现；复杂环境中的简单奖励能产生涌现复杂性。

views.en: Alignment based on human language and data is hitting limits; simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence.
views.zh: 基于人类语言与数据的对齐正触及极限；仿真是构建超级智能最安全、最快的地方。

views.en: A single goal is dangerous; many agents with diverse goals form a complex society where cooperation rises with intelligence.
views.zh: 单一目标危险；多目标智能体构成复杂社会，合作随智能提升而增加。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress; alignment is pressing; iterative deployment mitigates risks.
views.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展；对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署可缓解风险。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures must be designed early; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑；治理结构须尽早设计；能力测量成为瓶颈，基准落后。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is key for alignment and interpretability.
views.zh: 2026 年：持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控是对齐与可解释性的关键工具。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
views.zh: 2026 年：长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型将自主工作数日，需要新的监督范式。

views.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
views.zh: 2026 年：尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪上升；最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
views.zh: 先用全量数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，比直接在全量数据上训练更能攻克复杂任务。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and synthetic data is closer to RL than to simulation.
views.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，而合成数据更接近强化学习而非仿真。

views.en: Constraints and careful research can beat wasteful compute; more resources do not guarantee progress.
views.zh: 约束与细致研究可能胜过浪费式的算力投入；资源更多并不保证进步。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL, human interventions, and multi-timescale memory.
views.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度低得多；长期自主依赖可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与多时间尺度记忆。

views.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists, and starting generalist then fine-tuning beats per-site models.
views.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌微调专家模型，先通用再微调优于按站点从零训练。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI has spiky capabilities, so connecting models to the physical world is essential for science.
views.zh: 智能不是一个标量，AI 的能力是尖峰式的；因此把模型连接到物理世界，对加速科学至关重要。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical science, but Scaling alone won't solve science; experiments are irreplaceable.
views.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验会推动物理科学，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决不了科学问题，真实实验不可替代。

views.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments in a closed loop rather than rely on pre-training alone.
views.zh: 科学发现按定义就在训练数据之外，所以 AI 必须闭环地跑真实实验，而不能只依赖预训练。

views.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck.
views.zh: 高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要；自动化表征是最大的瓶颈。

views.en: AI self-improvement is happening in software engineering now but does not generalize; domain-specific data and multidisciplinary lab teams are essential.
views.zh: AI 自我改进目前在软件工程中正在发生，但不会自动泛化；领域专属数据与跨学科实验室团队必不可少。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Fireside Chat with Jeff Dean: The Evolution of TPUs and AI Infrastructure
Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven ML progress for 13-14 years; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已持续推动机器学习进步 13-14 年；算法与架构改进会随规模成倍放大。

views.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, RLHF steers behavior.
views.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导模型行为。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware become the real bottleneck, not training.
views.zh: 智能体式系统已能自主执行长任务；超低延迟推理与专用硬件成为真正瓶颈，而非训练。

views.en: Context engineering and taste matter more than coding; startups should target problems where frontier models fail almost completely.
views.zh: 上下文工程与品味比编码更重要；创业公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎完全失败的问题。

views.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method accelerate discovery.
views.zh: 从一开始就多模态训练的模型更优；递归自我改进与自动化科学方法将加速发现。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型的核心定在下一个词预测上，认为这是 AI-complete 问题；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）加算力和数据就能更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

views.en: Dialogue remains the killer app, but by 2025 he stresses models must act in the world, not just passively observe data.
views.zh: 对话始终是杀手级应用，但到 2025 年他更强调模型要在世界中采取行动，而不只是被动观察数据——从聊天走向智能体式行为。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the major near-term lever, yet he insists it alone won't reach AGI; agentic capability and reinforcement learning are also required.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把推理侧算力扩张视为近期最大杠杆，但明确说单靠它到不了 AGI（通用人工智能），还需要智能体能力与强化学习。

views.en: He deepens the scaling thesis: modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts and ever-longer context windows enable efficient scaling and continual learning.
views.zh: 他深化了 Scaling 主线：混合专家等模块化稀疏架构与超长上下文窗口，让高效扩展和持续学习成为可能，取代单体式重训。

views.en: Safety shifts from brand-risk caution to engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding capabilities; he now calls AGI underhyped and coding a self-accelerating application.
views.zh: 安全观从早期批评大厂因品牌风险畏手畏脚，转向工程防护、人类监督与理解模型能力；他如今称 AGI 被低估，编程是被低估的自我加速应用。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: John Schulman, Charlie O'Neill & Beren Millidge Debate the Road to Recursive Self-Improvement
Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

views.en: LLMs combine pre-training on internet text with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型看作预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐的组合；幻觉源于模型偏好似是而非的风格而非事实准确，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

views.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; progress needs new modalities, better methods, and scalable oversight rather than scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年他已预警：单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力会遇到收益递减，出路在视频等新模态、更好训练方法，以及用模型互评的可扩展监督，而非只靠缩放定律。

views.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; closed models fund big investment, open models aid research and fine-tuning flexibility.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代；闭源激励大投入，开源利于研究与微调灵活性。

views.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; bottlenecks are environments and data bits, not compute.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心从预训练转向强化学习：成功主要来自中期合成推理数据与高信噪比的单比特奖励，瓶颈是难而真实的强化学习环境和有用数据比特，而非算力。

views.en: Distillation spreads RL-learned few-bit behaviors, fighting centralization; parameter counts may plateau as long-horizon inference efficiency dominates.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：蒸馏让强化学习学到的少量比特行为易于复制，从而对抗中心化；随着长程推理效率成为主导，参数量可能见顶，而递归自我改进或许比现实工作更易累积推进。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation

OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough

From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年时他强调：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling faces diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩展面临收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence; models know their limits.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视 IMO 金牌为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠通用测试时算力扩展实现，且模型能自知局限。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for tokens, cost, or time.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准评估必须控制 token、成本或时间变量。

views.en: Multi-agent systems scale test-time compute in parallel, but powerful general models, not coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：多智能体系统并行扩展测试时算力，但突破靠强大通用模型而非协调；对齐是首要任务。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI requires embodiment, not just software behind a screen.
views.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身，而不只是屏幕后的软件。

views.en: Progress is not accelerating: we are as close to superhuman AI now as in the 1970s; hardware Scaling, not new algorithms, drove recent gains.
views.zh: 进展并未加速：我们如今离超人类 AI 的距离与 1970 年代相当；推动近期突破的是硬件层面的 Scaling，而非新算法。

views.en: AGI needs world models plus a separate controller; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers, and cannot reach AGI alone.
views.zh: AGI 需要世界模型加独立的控制器；LLM 是预测机器而非决策者，单靠它无法抵达 AGI。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as AIs will protect life.
views.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标；对安全的恐惧被夸大，AI 会保护生命。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will undercut closed frontier model companies.
views.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等五年能拿到便宜得多的算力，开源将侵蚀闭源前沿模型公司的优势。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；自对弈和模仿学习能提供强信号。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is key for warehouse robots.
views.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造价值。

views.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
views.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移至图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

views.en: A consistent thread: leveraging simulation, self-play, and transfer learning to bridge the gap between lab and real-world robotics.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：利用模拟、自对弈和迁移学习来弥合实验室与真实世界机器人之间的差距。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds into massive yearly growth; agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1% 的改进会复利成巨大的年度增长；智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，入门级岗位会消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, measured by token value per user; orchestration across models and devices creates real business value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为前沿在于智能体替你干活，核心指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型与设备的编排才创造真实商业价值。

views.en: Power and cost, not safety, are the biggest bottlenecks for 24/7 agents; local compute is the solution.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 24/7 智能体的最大瓶颈是电力与成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向人文视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代岗位，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from bricklayer to architect; base intelligence suffices, so the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从“砌砖者”变成“建筑师”；基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

views.en: Jevons paradox means AI yields more programmers, not fewer; demand for software grows as building gets cheaper.
views.zh: 2025 年，他用杰文斯悖论判断 AI 会带来更多而非更少的程序员：写软件越便宜，软件需求越大。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual improvement; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of product progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变而是渐进改进；产品创新落后于能力，即便冻结模型也还有十年产品空间。

views.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents coexist, with multiple agents working in parallel.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的落地观深化：企业采用智能体靠信任与权限而非完全自主；同步 IDE 与异步智能体并存，多个智能体并行协作。

views.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; measure outcomes not tokens, stay model-neutral, and the abundance era is near though the singularity is not imminent.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向规模化与“丰裕时代”：编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍，应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，保持模型中立；丰裕时代临近，但奇点并不迫近。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但还不够好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

views.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, a shift from expecting to rely only on frontier models.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的立场深化为：定制模型成为 Cursor 每个惊艳体验的关键，这偏离了最初只依赖前沿模型的预期。

views.en: Programming moves from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste more valuable than carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握方向，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

views.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; hiring should be slower and focused on world-class talent.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性且需数十年展开，招聘应更慢、只招世界级人才，这与常见创业建议相反。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and never revert—fix forward.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用短提示迭代对话，永不回滚，而是让智能体向前修复。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the open internet.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，公开联网前必须沙箱隔离。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run with any model, but can be financially unsustainable and need opinionated focus.
views.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型，但财务上可能不可持续，需要坚持主见、保持聚焦。

views.en: Fun and gut instinct drive the best ideas: fix what annoys you, live in the future, and build what's missing rather than chasing polish.
views.zh: 乐趣与直觉催生最好的想法：修复让你烦恼的事，活在未来，构建缺失之物，而非追求企业式打磨。

views.en: The real bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model capability; perpetual agents are a token problem.
views.zh: 智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力与 token 管理，而非模型能力；常驻智能体本质是 token 问题。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute and conviction; self-play and scale point toward AGI, with societal impact weighed before release.
views.zh: 2020 年，他把深度学习的成功归因于大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合，认为自博弈是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键，并强调在发布强大模型前要考虑社会影响。

views.en: Scale matters only if you scale the right thing; next-token prediction yields world understanding, and reliability plus alignment are the real barriers.
views.zh: 2023 年，他深化为“要 Scale 对的东西”：下一个词预测能带来世界理解，而真正的瓶颈是可靠性与对齐，超级智能的对齐极难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; reasoning tokens and research ideas now matter more than brute compute, and eval gains may not generalize.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，立场明显转变：预训练缩放定律有尽头，推理 token 与研究想法比堆算力更重要，评测提升未必代表真实泛化。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life, perhaps via human-AI neural integration.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的系统，并认为若 AI 自身有感知、关怀生命，对齐或更容易，长期均衡可能靠神经连接实现人机融合。

views.en: A consistent thread: neural networks learn representations and understanding from prediction, while safety and control must keep pace with growing capability.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：神经网络通过预测学习表征与理解，而安全与控制必须跟上能力的增长。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

AI and the Future: From Chess to DeepMind

views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with games as testbeds.
views.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应建成通用学习系统而非窄化预编程；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆/想象力是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，游戏是理想试验场。

views.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; AGI within a decade needs planning/search, multimodal grounding, and algorithmic innovation, not Scaling alone.
views.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶；十年内实现 AGI 需结合规划/搜索、多模态接地与算法创新，不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference; classical learning can model physics without embodiment, but new breakthroughs may be needed.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立；经典学习无需具身即可建模物理，但 AGI 可能还需新突破，而非仅靠 Scaling。

views.en: AGI needs 50% Scaling and 50% innovation; world models, continual learning, memory, and agents are missing pieces; timelines tighten to 3-10 years.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AGI 需一半 Scaling、一半创新；世界模型、持续学习、记忆与智能体是关键缺失拼图，时间表收紧至 3-10 年。

views.en: Safety and societal benefit are constant threads: early safety research, AlphaFold-style science, and now collective government regulation over lab self-regulation.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全与社会福祉：从早期呼吁安全研究、以 AlphaFold 推动科学，到如今主张政府集体监管而非实验室自律。

people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety research needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他承认缩放定律只是经验规律、并不完全理解其为何平滑，并强调对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is only ~3% understood yet crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, with RSP thresholds.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为关键但承认只理解约 3%，同时提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要，并用负责任扩展政策的阈值触发安全措施。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not a sudden AGI leap; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating rather than slowing.
views.zh: 2025 年他明确反对 AGI 式突变叙事，主张能力沿指数平滑爬升，安全与能力不可分割，最大风险是过热而非减速。

views.en: A 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years; interpretability and third-party evaluation must keep pace.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出更激进的时间表：数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，同时强调可解释性与第三方评估必须同步跟上。

views.en: From scaling skeptic-of-mystery to policy advocate: high GDP with high unemployment, chip controls, and layered safeguards like Swiss cheese.
views.zh: 到 2026 年末，他从技术观察者转为政策倡导者：高 GDP 与高失业并存、对威权国家切断芯片供应、以及“瑞士奶酪”式多层防护。

people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。
