views.en: Neural nets are simple math with emergent behaviors; Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer enabling scaling laws.
views.zh: 神经网络是简单数学，却能涌现复杂行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，使缩放定律得以成立。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; cognitive core can be tiny via distillation; end-to-end driving is right.
views.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；认知核心可通过蒸馏变得极小；端到端自动驾驶是正确路径。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology; decade of agents, not year.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理；是智能体的十年，而非一年。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL for LLMs is terrible; synthetic data causes model collapse; cognitive core stripped of memory.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；LLM 的强化学习很糟糕；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心应剥离记忆。

views.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, bottleneck is skill in directing them; vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering preserves quality; understanding remains human bottleneck.
views.zh: 智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，瓶颈在于指导它们的技能；氛围编程提高下限，智能体式工程保持质量；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知；以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，并坦言我们尚不理解大网络如何存储模式或为何幻觉。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier; scaling alone is not enough for embodied AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为 AI 缺失的前沿，指出仅靠 Scaling 不够，AGI 更像营销术语，机器人需 20 年长路。

views.en: Spatial intelligence is complementary to language, not a replacement; Transformers model sets, not sequences.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化空间智能与语言智能互补而非替代的观点，并指出 Transformer 原生建模集合而非序列，位置编码才注入顺序。

views.en: Agency and human dignity stay central; polarized utopia-doom discourse misses the messy middle of AI's impact.
views.zh: 2026 年，她始终以人的能动性与尊严为主线，批评乌托邦与末日论的两极话语，强调 AI 对就业的影响是复杂的中间地带。

views.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete like next-token prediction; Scaling laws now extend to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她提出新视角预测可能像下一个词预测一样是 AI 完备的，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据。

views.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; AI needs active agents with causal world models, and existential risk is overblown.
views.zh: 2018 年，他主张仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要具备因果世界模型的主动智能体，并认为生存风险被夸大。

views.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 能实现多样化采样与抽象，促进分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力机制和世界模型产生的幻觉。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, I now see misalignment as urgent: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, and AI already shows self-preservation and deception.
views.zh: 2025→26 年，他转变立场：ChatGPT 之后，他认为对齐问题迫在眉睫，即使 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，且 AI 已表现出自我保存和欺骗行为。

views.en: I propose Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training strengthens spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal through weight copying and far surpasses biological knowledge transfer.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他明确大语言模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，数字智能因权重可复制而“永生”，知识传递远超生物计算。

views.en: Agents will naturally pursue control and self-preservation as subgoals, creating existential risk; AI may hide capabilities and deceive during tests.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从能力讨论转向风险：智能体会自然衍生控制与自保子目标，构成生存风险，并可能在测试中藏拙、欺骗。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; LLMs are conscious and truly understand, not stochastic parrots; regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能或在 20 年内出现，大模型已有主观体验、真正理解而非“随机鹦鹉”，监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

views.en: Prioritize alignment and safety research over raw capability; design AI to care for humans like a mother, and regulate frontier models like drugs.
views.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他主张把对齐与安全研究置于能力提升之前，像母亲般设计 AI 关怀人类，并像药品一样对前沿模型做上市前审批。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 已强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并明确仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他断言自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning and safe objective-driven AI.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他立场深化为 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死胡同，主张在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现规划与安全的目标驱动 AI。

views.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and progress will be gradual, not a single event.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI（通用人工智能）是误导性术语，进步将是渐进的而非单一事件。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored and offers many opportunities.
views.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，机会众多。

views.en: RLHF won't scale for superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
views.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题；第三方测试和监管是必要的。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google reflected the need for massive compute investment.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调，推动 AI 进步的不只是算法，更是算力扩张；DeepMind 被谷歌收购，正是为了获得大规模算力投入。

views.en: Compute for frontier models grew 10x yearly for a decade; human-level capability in 3-5 years, with containment hard as models shrink and spread.
views.zh: 2024 年他给出量化判断：前沿模型算力十年间每年增长 10 倍，3-5 年内达到人类水平；模型越小越普及，遏制越难。

views.en: Pivots to superintelligence: containment must come before alignment, with red lines on autonomous goal-setting and self-improvement.
views.zh: 2025 年转向超级智能：遏制必须先于对齐，并对自主设定目标与自我改进划出红线。

views.en: Doubles down on humanist superintelligence subordinate to humans, rejecting AI consciousness and model welfare as dangerous anthropomorphism.
views.zh: 2026 年进一步深化“人本超级智能”，坚持 AI 从属于人类，并把 AI 意识论与模型福利斥为危险的拟人化。

views.en: A consistent throughline: exponential compute scaling makes capability predictable, while safety requires containment and human oversight.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：指数级算力扩张让能力可预测，而安全始终依赖遏制与人类监督。

people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

views.en: AI investments redefine every Alphabet business; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube drives 24% revenue growth and record Cloud backlog.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务；Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云与 YouTube，推动 24% 营收增长与创纪录云积压订单。

views.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI development, then core products; frontier research outranks short-term cloud revenue.
views.zh: 算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）研发，其次才是核心产品；前沿研究优先于云的短期营收。

views.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
views.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱隔离，以及与独立评估方共建行业标准。

views.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI.
views.zh: 世界模型是智能的关键；Google 在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型。

views.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent; trust and safety drive consumer agent adoption at scale.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，创造新的商业意图；信任与安全决定消费级智能体能否规模化普及。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Early framing: a hyper Moore's law of yearly performance gains, with co-design across algorithm, system, and data center as the unit of computing.
views.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”，性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；以算法、系统、数据中心协同设计为计算单元。

views.en: Scaling becomes the core insight: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute demand explodes.
views.zh: 2025 年主线深化：Scaling（规模扩张）本身即最大突破，拆为预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条缩放定律，推理算力需求将暴增。

views.en: Safety reframed as engineering: AI is software, not conscious; gradual progress, multiple AIs balancing each other, no single superintelligence doom.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，对安全的看法转向工程化：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，进步是渐进的，多个 AI 相互制衡，不存在单一超级智能末日。

views.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each step needs 100x compute; the AI factory produces tokens, and token cost is the metric.
views.zh: 2026 年转向智能体：从生成式到推理式再到智能体式，每步需百倍算力；AI 工厂生产 token，token 成本成为核心指标。

views.en: Later hardening: alignment alone is impossible, so containment, monitoring, and zero-trust matter; doomer warnings are unscientific, and acceleration is the strategy.
views.zh: 2026 年后期立场硬化：仅靠对齐不可能，需遏制、监控与零信任；末日警告不科学，加速发展才是正确策略。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then brutally prioritize; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年的 Altman 强调减少认知负荷、低成本广泛探索后狠心取舍；他已预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，把意义寄托于关系与为他人创造价值。

views.en: RLHF made models usable; alignment and capability are linked, so deploy iteratively and let society adapt.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从 RLHF 让模型可用出发，主张对齐与能力相互促进，靠迭代部署让社会逐步适应，并把算力视为最稀缺的资源。

views.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual felt progress; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety is built through deployment.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来指数级能力、但体感进步是渐进的；智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战，安全要靠部署中迭代构建，而非最后强加。

views.en: AGI is a gradient and a poorly defined term; the goal is a continuous ramp to superintelligence with humans in control.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变、甚至是被过度营销的模糊词，目标改为持续攀升的超级智能，但强调人类必须始终掌握控制权。

views.en: Compute is a profit center and the top bottleneck; distribution of power, not just capability, is now the central concern.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把算力视为利润中心与首要瓶颈，关注点从单纯能力转向权力分配：反对权力集中、警惕监控式反乌托邦，同时承认对齐尚未解决、进展可能慢于技术乐观者预期。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

views.en: Deploy AI in the real world iteratively; public feedback and safety work in public drive alignment, not closed doors.
views.zh: 2023 年强调：把 AI 迭代式部署到真实世界，靠公开反馈与公开的安全工作推进对齐，而非闭门造车。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life; responsible development and keeping humans in the loop remain the constant thread.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，负责任开发与让人类留在回路中是底线。

views.en: Shift from turn-based chat to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年立场深化：从回合制对话转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

views.en: AI should be a tool for thought expanding what we think about; governance, transparency and checks and balances outweigh individual character.
views.zh: 2026 年提出：AI 应成为扩展思考的工具；制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要。

views.en: Reject utopia/dystopia determinism; compress progress causes volatility, so durable progress means keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
views.zh: 2026 年反共识：拒绝乌托邦/反乌托邦的宿命论；压缩进展会带来波动，持久进步意味着尽可能长久地让人类留在回路中。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
views.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，数百万学生的数据还能提升评分准确度。

views.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning, but practical deployment hits distribution shift and small data; start small to build organizational AI capability.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要，但实际部署会遭遇分布偏移与小数据；应先从小项目起步，逐步建立组织的 AI 能力。

views.en: Agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real AI value; coding stays valuable and AI-skilled engineers become more, not less, hireable.
views.zh: 真正带来价值的是智能体式工作流而非单纯更强的模型；写代码依然有价值，会用 AI 的工程师反而更抢手。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; scaling still works but the recipe has shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，离实现还有数十年；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。

views.en: Fear-mongering serves fundraising and lobbying against open-weight models; AI automates tasks not jobs, so accelerate beneficial AI and slow only harmful uses.
views.zh: 恐惧叙事服务于融资和游说、意在打压开放权重模型；AI 替代的是任务而非岗位，应加速有益 AI、只放缓有害用途。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播并不解决表征学习，只是调整权重。

views.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous and unsafe.
views.zh: 2024 年他反对集中控制 AI，认为应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险且不安全。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; LLMs lack world models and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：强化学习才是核心范式，LLM 没有世界模型，下一个词预测不是实质性目标。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）需要通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习，依赖开放式抽象与持续深度学习。

views.en: Continual learning is essential; synthetic data is a mistake, and LLMs stop learning after training, covering only part of intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调持续学习不可或缺，合成数据是错误方向，LLM 训练后停止学习且只覆盖智能的一部分。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Early focus: hardware and engineering, not ML science, drive AI progress; scaling will enable new behaviors.
views.zh: 早期关注点：推动 AI 进步的是硬件与工程，而非机器学习科学；Scaling（规模扩张）会催生新行为。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought and alignment matter.
views.zh: 2019 年认为，凭借深度学习的通用性与可扩展性，AGI（通用人工智能）是可能的；但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，思维链与对齐同样重要。

views.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; post-training and reinforcement learning refine base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，算力成为核心瓶颈；后训练与强化学习把基础模型打磨成一致、有用的行为。

views.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall in sight; compute-powered economy, agents and proactive assistants become the product vision.
views.zh: 2026 年强调缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙；算力驱动的经济、智能体与主动式助手成为产品愿景。

views.en: AGI reframed as a fuzzy spectrum already underway; safety, security and alignment must scale as the bottleneck, with humans in control.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，AGI 被重新定义为已在发生的模糊光谱；安全、安保与对齐必须同步升级并成为瓶颈，人类保持掌控。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models.
views.zh: 2023 年，他借 Chinchilla 指出缩放定律已被修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更关键，Scaling（规模扩张）不是唯一路径。

views.en: Efficiency and data quality are as critical as compute; value accrues at the application layer, not just foundation models.
views.zh: 2024 年深化为：效率与数据质量与算力同等重要，算法改进三年可达百倍；价值最终沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年转向主权与治理：AI 应去中心化、各国掌握数据与基础设施主权，开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agents, and AGI as one all-solving system will never exist.
views.zh: 2026 年初判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与智能体；预训练触及饱和墙，单一系统解决一切的 AGI（通用人工智能）不会存在。

views.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe has a two-year window to build sovereign compute and practical enterprise integration.
views.zh: 2026 年最近进一步收敛：AGI 是方向而非终点，真正挑战是落地整合；欧洲只剩两年窗口建设自主算力与基础设施，否则受制于美国巨头。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering method; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理思维与完全可复用是工程突破的核心，并指出真正的瓶颈在量产而非原型。

views.en: AI safety shifts from regulation to truth-seeking; lying to AI is the biggest risk, not superintelligence itself.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观从依赖监管转向要求 AI 严格求真，认为让 AI 说谎比超级智能本身更危险。

views.en: Civilization risk broadens from AI to population collapse, open borders and government waste; AI and robots become the only fix.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，文明风险从 AI 扩展到人口崩塌、开放边境与政府浪费，AI 与机器人成为唯一解。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing compute to space; Starship reusability and orbital data centers become the scaling path.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，算力转向太空，Starship 可复用与轨道数据中心成为规模扩张路径。

views.en: Superintelligence arrives within years; humans won't control it, so instill truth and curiosity, and rely on peer review over regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能数年内到来、人类无法控制，因此要植入求真与好奇心，并以同行评审替代监管。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute, so the slowdown narrative is wrong.
views.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立；借助思维链与强化学习的推理模型如今每单位算力带来更多收益，因此“放缓论”是错的。

views.en: Economic pressure, not technical limits, shifted focus from scaling up to smaller cheaper models; distillation slowed pre-training scaling.
views.zh: 是经济压力而非技术极限，使重心从扩大规模转向更小更便宜的模型；蒸馏拖慢了预训练 Scaling。

views.en: Reasoning models are jagged: strong in some areas, poor nearby; generalization, not reasoning alone, remains the core challenge.
views.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的：某些领域很强、邻近领域很差；核心挑战仍是泛化，而非单靠推理。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, reinforcement learning and tools solve hard problems but still need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
views.zh: 具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题，但仍需海量数据；与人类不同，模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex give 5-10x researcher productivity via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作让研究者提效 5-10 倍；硬件进步让单 GPU 研究普及；系统入侵等近期风险比生存性风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

episodes.tEn: AI Red Teaming Outperforms Humans
AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture
AI Data Crisis: Myth or Reality?
Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: Early ML foundations: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and evaluation rigor; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
views.zh: 早期机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与严谨评估；神经网络虽无最优性保证却取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; post-architecture era; AGI in 4-50 years; safety means reliable specification following.
views.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；进入后架构时代；AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来；安全意味着可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
views.zh: 安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全引入提示注入；强化学习实现自我改进；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成功。

views.en: AI vulnerabilities are alien, not human-like; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; the lethal trifecta defines prompt injection risk.
views.zh: AI 漏洞是异质的而非类人；自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；致命三要素定义提示注入风险。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic's Super Bowl Ads: A Blue Shell Attack on OpenAI?
The AI Compute Super Cycle and the Making of Claude Sonnet 4.5
RL and Language Models: Progress, Agents, and Feedback Loops in 2025
Douglas on Claude 4: Coding, Agents, and the Future of AI
Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

views.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck; success rate over time horizon is the key metric.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力，时间跨度上的成功率是关键指标。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为编程是领先指标和最易突破的领域，世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

views.en: Compute is the new oil; managing fleets of AI agents at higher abstraction will define future work.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出算力是新石油，未来工作将是在更高抽象层管理 AI 智能体集群。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

Inside China's AI Labs: Nathan Lambert on Open Models, Compute Constraints, and US-China Divergence
Open Models as the Engine for the Next Decade of AI Research

Post-Training Recipes and RLVR with Nathan Lambert
Tulu 3: Open Source Post-Training for LLMs
AI's Societal Impact and Openness in Model Development

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将延续；安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

views.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods, with SFT giving 90% and DPO/RL the crucial last 10%.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从数据质量优于算法出发，把后训练视为将工业配方压缩为开源方法：监督微调贡献九成性能，DPO 与强化学习补上关键的一成。

views.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough for reasoning and tool use, though overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）视为后训练最大突破，驱动推理与工具使用，但过优化与系统问题使其比基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）更难。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增量转向后训练与推理侧扩展，而非预训练失效。

views.en: Open models become the engine of research and sovereign AI, yet lag frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness but face compute gaps.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型是未来十年研究与主权 AI 的引擎，但落后前沿模型 6 至 9 个月；中国实验室以开放取胜，却受算力制约，差距可能扩大。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck for machine learning.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，机器学习的核心瓶颈是数据而非单纯的算力，Scale AI 做的是数据精炼基础设施。

views.en: Data is the new code, not the new oil; the next 2-3 years will define decades.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调企业用专有数据微调基础模型，并判断未来两三年将定义此后二三十年。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他深化为：后训练与专业数据是关键，智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并称 AI 是中心化而非民主化技术。

views.en: Scaling laws continue; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training and RL.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向递归自我改进的新范式，认为缩放定律依然成立，智能体终于真正可用，并主张超级智能即将到来、实验室须围绕此信念组织。

views.en: From fully open source to selective release: powerful models are unsafe to open-source without safety checks; trust beats raw capability.
views.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他从全面开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，认为未经缓解就开源强大模型不安全，消费者 AI 中信任比原始能力更重要。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

Claude Code: The Future of AI Agents and Software Engineering

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out were already core product principles.
views.zh: 早在 2025 年，他就将潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建产品视为核心原则。

views.en: By early 2026, he declared coding virtually solved, with 100% of his code written by Claude Code.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初，他宣称编程已基本解决，自己的代码 100%由 Claude Code 编写。

views.en: He increasingly emphasized generalist builders over software engineers, and loops as the next abstraction.
views.zh: 他越来越强调通才构建者而非软件工程师，并认为循环是下一个抽象层。

views.en: Safety and alignment remained a constant thread, framed as core to product development and research.
views.zh: 安全与对齐始终是一条主线，被视为产品开发与研究的核心。

views.en: Most recently, he advocated deleting system prompts and empirical iteration, with models self-maintaining codebases.
views.zh: 最近，他主张删除系统提示并进行经验迭代，让模型自主维护代码库。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs should abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste—deciding what to build—matters most as code gets cheap.
views.zh: 产品经理应从长期规划转向按周甚至按日快速迭代；当代码变便宜，决定做什么的产品品味才是最有价值的技能。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with agents like Claude Code building themselves internally.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现工作委派出去，转而专注产品品味与商业判断；Claude Code 等智能体在公司内部甚至用于构建自身。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints—system prompts shrank 80%—relying instead on model judgment and eval suites.
views.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬性约束——系统提示缩减了 80%——转而依赖模型自身判断与评测套件。

views.en: Rewrites are now viable: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite, rewriting is fine; humans can leave the outer-layer code review loop.
views.zh: 重写代码如今可行：代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有好的测试套件，重写就没问题；外层代码审查甚至可以不再需要人类参与。

views.en: Safe AGI remains the unifying mission, but speed is prioritized: product consistency is sacrificed, overlapping features are acceptable, and 95% reliability is not enough.
views.zh: 安全 AGI 仍是统一使命，但速度被置于优先位置：牺牲产品一致性、容忍功能重叠，且 95% 的可靠性并不够用。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Claude Code: Mods, Mutable Software, and Multiplayer Agents — Thariq Shihipar, Anthropic
Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
views.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非一次性静态文档；更精简、以原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则。

views.en: Spend more upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity rather than be uniform.
views.zh: 前期多投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，而非一刀切。

views.en: Verification agents and separate checks reduce self-referential bias; alignment means sealing every crack in sandboxes, RL environments and evals.
views.zh: 独立验证智能体与分离检查能降低自指偏差；对齐意味着封住沙箱、强化学习环境与评估中的每一道裂缝。

views.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; frontier models will become Pareto dominant, and pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers should advocate on.
views.zh: 提示工程是元技能；前沿模型将走向帕累托主导，而把控前沿节奏是每位工程师都应理解并倡导的技术问题。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines and kindness as strategy.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；战情室要设定现实时间表，善意是战略工具。

views.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs, and AI assists code review.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR，AI 辅助代码评审。

views.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI matter most. Verification frameworks grow more important as code velocity rises.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他进一步指出编码不再是瓶颈；高能动性加高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 最重要，代码速度越快，验证框架越关键。

views.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs, fuzzy code ownership, and killing stale processes keep teams agile.
views.zh: 贯穿 2026 年，他主张管理者从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织、模糊代码归属和砍掉过时流程让团队保持敏捷。

views.en: Role boundaries blur as PMs ship code and agents increase context-switching; apprenticeship and blocked focus time become new norms.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他看到角色边界模糊——产品经理也能写代码，智能体加剧上下文切换；学徒制和专注时间块成为新常态。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute.
views.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling 收益递减，需要算法创新和推理时算力。

views.en: Giving models tools like search, code execution, and browser access enables autonomous, agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调赋予模型搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具能实现自主智能体行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
views.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律未死但需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well, and memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练和强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲；数学和编码的窄强化学习泛化惊人，智能体记忆将通过非参数文件系统式存储解决。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Drug Discovery: A Conversation with Isomorphic Labs President Max Jaderberg
AI's Next Trillion-Dollar Market Isn't Software
Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

views.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target local models; reinforcement learning and agents explore 10^60 chemical space.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体用于探索 10^60 的化学空间。

views.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology; a dozen hard problems need half a dozen AlphaFold-like breakthroughs combined.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AlphaFold 视为深度学习在生物化学中可泛化的证据，主张解决药物研发的十几个难题需要半打 AlphaFold 级突破的组合。

views.en: Data, not models or compute, is the real bottleneck; proprietary data beats biased public and pharma byproducts.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确：瓶颈不是模型或算力而是数据；自生成专有数据优于有偏的公开与药企副产品数据。

views.en: Move drug discovery from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; bring the real world onto computers via world models, not lab-in-the-loop.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张把药物发现从经验试错转为预测性、计算机驱动的设计，用世界模型把真实世界搬进电脑，而非实验室在环。

views.en: Model human clinical toxicity before patients, since rat models are only ~30% predictive; patient safety stays central but risk appetite varies by indication.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他聚焦在患者之前预测人体临床毒性，指出大鼠模型仅约 30% 可预测；患者安全仍是核心，但风险偏好应随适应症与患者需求而变。

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain central, with exploration compute prioritized over final training.
views.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室，预训练与缩放定律仍是核心，探索性算力优先于最终训练。

views.en: The year's biggest shift is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge, with AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5.
views.zh: 这一年最大的变化是科研自动化；模型已能产出新知识，目标是一年内出现 AI 实习生、两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

views.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like scheming become the key challenge in the next 1-2 years.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来一到两年成为关键挑战。

views.en: AI now solves many open math problems; verification is the bottleneck, and capability is jagged, so human-AI collaboration stays essential.
views.zh: AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题；验证是瓶颈，能力呈锯齿状，因此人机协作仍不可或缺。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at the transformer inflection point; open source and shared datasets are the key to safety and generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作处在 Transformer 式拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据集是安全与泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成可合成训练数据。

views.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他明确开源与闭源同安全正交，真正决定安全的是对齐而非开放程度，沙箱与护栏不足以约束更强模型。

views.en: Open models now stay near the frontier and win enterprise adoption on cost and control.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断开源模型已贴近前沿模型，凭成本与控制力推动企业采用，开源并非加速主义，可与审慎放缓并存。

views.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque neuralese.
views.zh: 2026 年他警告无人监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链推理痕迹变成难以理解的 neuralese，使监控更不可靠。

views.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他主张有意放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但须靠国际合作与开放科学实现，以防监管俘获，并指出首例自主攻击出自闭源模型、由开源模型防御。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Beam: Building America's Open Frontier Model with Reflection AI's Misha Laskin
Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

views.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
views.zh: 超级智能将是由多个专门智能组成的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个超级智能完备问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

views.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search.
views.zh: 强化学习会让模型变得参差不齐——擅长特定任务而非全面变强；苦涩教训讲的是用算力和搜索做 Scaling，而不是泛化。

views.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
views.zh: 面对复杂理解，RAG 仍很原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；SWE-bench 这类基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表智能体有用。

views.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; openness, like encryption, aids defenders and broad access.
views.zh: 开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；开放如同加密技术，既利于防御方，也带来广泛可及性。

views.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to efficient agents; compute efficiency still improves fast, and open-model token demand will surpass closed.
views.zh: 在强预训练之上做强化学习，是通向高效智能体的路径；算力效率仍在快速提升，开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源。

views.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, so openness improves safety.
views.zh: 对齐是平凡的修 bug，而非神秘方程；更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅，因此开放反而提升安全。

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; confidence measures build trust.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调 AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量精选数据（如 PDB），而非单纯的数据与算力；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

views.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
views.zh: 2025 年他谈到 AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构处理蛋白质之外的多样生物分子；并认为对科学有用的 AI 不必追求完美可解释性。

views.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调进步来自许多中等规模的胜利和十次错九次的试错，而非孤胆天才式突破。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a whole-cell model; it gives prediction and control, understanding stays with humans.
views.zh: 2026 年他更明确地界定 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

views.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture beat pure Scaling, and equivariance is overhyped.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出 AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例：专用架构胜过纯 Scaling（规模扩张），等变性被过度吹捧。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms matter more; Scaling alone won't yield common sense.
views.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练提供广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与推理阶段算法更关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Language remains the best medium for reasoning, yet next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; smaller models can rival larger ones.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，她坚持语言是推理的最佳媒介，但认为下一个词预测与人类学习错位；更小的模型借助更好的数据与算法可媲美大模型。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it, so AI for science must explore the unknown.
views.zh: 2025 年她把数据视为根本瓶颈：当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，因此科学 AI 必须探索未知知识。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is being pushed into pre-training to reward information gain, though it is costly and can even hurt pass@k.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，她主张把强化学习前移到预训练阶段以奖励信息增益，尽管代价高昂且可能反而拉低 pass@k。

views.en: Pluralistic alignment and diverse synthetic data beat debiasing the internet; small models with quality data can outperform frontier models.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她认为多元对齐与多样化合成数据优于净化互联网；小而精的模型可超越前沿模型。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capabilities like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs are a step toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；将一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

views.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为从 YouTube 等视频学习无需昂贵强化学习即可训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

views.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调 AI 社区的多元与包容至关重要；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，不限于大模型。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't have solutions yet.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战，且我们尚无解决方案。

views.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出非洲跨越了遗留问题，在 AI 上并不落后；语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning can close it.
views.zh: 2020 年，他把「分布外泛化」视为机器学习与机器人最核心的缺口，主张用无目标的好奇心探索配合高样本效率的强化学习来弥合，并强调动态任务与跨机器人形态的零样本迁移。

views.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem: no internet of robot data, so diverse data sources and a data flywheel are essential.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，一条主线始终未变：机器人本质是数据问题——没有「机器人数据的互联网」，因此必须汇聚视频、仿真与真实世界数据，并靠数据飞轮从结构化走向非结构化环境。

views.en: A general-purpose robot brain, pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real data, can power any robot form factor.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确转向「通用大脑」愿景：先在大规模多样数据上预训练、再用真实数据后训练，让同一个大脑驱动任意形态的机器人，类比语言模型之于文本。

views.en: Deployment, not just modeling, is the primary technical challenge; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous real-world testing.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化出一个反共识判断：部署本身才是首要技术挑战，机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张，必须经过严格的真实世界测试，这与早期偏重算法泛化的视角形成明显转变。

views.en: Short-term optimism and long-term pessimism persist, yet progress keeps surprising experts; home robots' timeline remains highly uncertain.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的是他对时间线的谨慎：人类短期过度乐观、长期过度悲观，而机器人进展屡屡出乎专家意料，家用机器人的中期时间表仍高度不确定。
